/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8 and 8.4): the console's words of what a program does and of the edge's purge, each under the
 * design's key. Task 3 brings the four lines of the edge's purge; every number is EDGE_WORDS', never typed, and the time
 * is the answer's, printed by the screen with bothTimes.
 */
export const AUTOMATION_WORDS = {
  /**
   * [case.purge.accepted], [case.purge.failed], [case.purge.off] and [case.purge.pending]: beside each image of a case
   * that stopped being public, and for each image of an order's disabled item, from the newest outbox row's outcome.
   */
  purge: (outcome: EdgePurgeView["outcome"], at: string): string => {
    switch (outcome) {
      case "accepted":
        return `Edge copy: purge accepted at ${at}.`;
      case "failed":
        return `Edge copy: purge failed. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes after the measure; the operator is alerted.`;
      case "off":
        return `Edge copy: no purge (off): a copy may be served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes.`;
      case "pending":
        return "Edge copy: purge not sent yet.";
    }
  },
  /**
   * Task 6 (8.3): the queue's three chips, [queue.found], [queue.taken] and [queue.objected]. Only the last moves a case:
   * the API sorts it first inside its lane.
   */
  queue: { found: "Found by a program", taken: "Taken by a program", objected: "The author asked for a person" },
  /** Task 6 (8.4): the chip in the place of a staff handle, on a decision without a decider and on Home's lists. */
  byProgram: "Taken by a program",
  /** Task 6: a program's finding as the case's history names its item. */
  historyItem: "a program's finding",
  /** [home.automated] (8.2): the measures of a program in force, which wait for a person; `oldestAt` printed by the screen. */
  homeAutomated: (waiting: number, oldestAt: string) =>
    `Measures a program took, waiting for a person: ${waiting}, the oldest since ${oldestAt}. A moderator decides a hidden image; an admin answers sealed images.`,
  /** [home.objected] (8.2): the cases whose author asked for a person; the target is the contracts' constant. */
  homeObjected: (objected: number, oldestObjectionAt: string) =>
    `The author asked for a person: ${objected} ${objected === 1 ? "case" : "cases"}, the oldest request of ${oldestObjectionAt}. korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours.`,
  /** [case.r1] (8.4), on an item a score opened: the threshold's version and never the score, which would read as a verdict. */
  caseR1: (thresholdVersion: number) =>
    `A program rated this image as likely within rule R1: over the threshold (version ${thresholdVersion}). That is a reason to look, not a finding. Look at the image and decide as for any report. The statement will say that a moderator looked at the image only if you opened it on this case before you decided; otherwise it says that you decided without opening it.`,
  /** [case.auto] (8.4), on a decision without a decider, before the statement's preview its author was sent. */
  caseAuto: (decidedAt: string, measure: string) =>
    `A program took this measure at ${decidedAt}, with no person involved: ${measure}. It lasts until a person decides this case. Its author was told at once, with these words:`,
  /** [case.autoR1] (8.4), for a program's withhold of an image. */
  caseAutoR1: 'Any moderator may lift it now ("Lift what was done while deciding", with your reason), or decide the case. A final decision ends it either way.',
  /** [case.autoRecord] (8.4), beside "Decide the case" while an unanswered item of the case is a program's finding. */
  caseAutoRecord: "Your decision is recorded as found by automated means.",
  /** [case.objection] (8.4), at the top of the case while its measure is in force: the lead, the frame's label, the end. */
  objection: {
    lead: (createdAt: string) => `The author asked for a person on ${createdAt}:`,
    by: "Written by the author",
    tail: `korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours. Lift the measure or decide the case; either way the author gets that decision's statement, and nothing else answers this.`,
  },
  /** 3d Task 7 [queue.matchFlag] (8.3): a match that only flags; it moves nothing. */
  queueMatchFlag: "A match that only flags",
  /**
   * 3d Task 8 [queue.flag] (8.3), and the chip beside [case.flag]: the flag "possible coordinated reporting". It moves
   * nothing: the case stands where its lane and age put it.
   */
  queueFlag: "Possible coordinated reporting",
  /**
   * [case.flag] (8.4), under the case's header with the chip: the two counts from the answer, the window's minutes and the
   * linked share from SIGNAL_RULES (the share as a word while it is one half). It names no reporter.
   */
  caseFlag: (items: number, reporters: number) =>
    `Many reports in a short time from accounts that are linked: ${items} unanswered reports from ${reporters} accounts within ${SIGNAL_RULES.windowMinutes} minutes, and at least ${SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare === 0.5 ? "half" : `${SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare * 100} percent`} of those accounts follow one another. This is not a finding: decide the content as always.`,
  /** [case.sameSource] (8.4), on an item whose signed-in reporter has other unanswered items on other open cases: a count, never a case. */
  sameSource: (n: number) => `${n} other open ${n === 1 ? "item" : "items"} from this source.`,
  /** [home.flags] (8.2). */
  homeFlags: (flags: number) =>
    `Matches that only flag: ${flags} open cases hold one, a match with an entry that its source does not class as child sexual abuse material. Each stands in the queue where its lane and age put it.`,
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 [case.match] (8.4): a match's record as a list of label and value. The source, the list version and the
   * classification are a source's strings, drawn framed under `frame`, never in a label's place (rule 3 of section 8).
   */
  match: {
    title: "The match's record",
    frame: "As the source returned it",
    source: "Source",
    listVersion: "List version",
    hashType: "Hash type",
    matchKind: "Kind of match, as the source reported it",
    classification: "Classification, as the source returned it",
    queriedAt: "Compared at",
    none: "not returned",
    /** [case.matchWeak]: under the record for a hash that can be made to collide on purpose, or a perceptual one. */
    weak: (hashType: "sha256" | "sha1" | "md5" | "pdq"): string | null =>
      hashType === "md5"
        ? "A file with the same MD5 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
        : hashType === "sha1"
          ? "A file with the same SHA-1 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
          : hashType === "pdq"
            ? "A perceptual hash describes how a picture looks. Two different pictures can have the same one, by accident or on purpose."
            : null,
    /** [case.matchActing]. */
    acting:
      "The source reports this as an exact match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material. That is the one kind of match on which korbat's program refuses an upload or, where the owner has switched that on, seals a post's images. It is the source's word about a fingerprint: nobody at korbat has checked it, and nobody can.",
    /** [case.matchNear]. */
    near: "The source reports this as a match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material, but it is not a match on which korbat's program acts: the source does not report it as exact (the kind of match is shown above), or the entry is outside the part of its list that korbat acts on. The program refused and sealed nothing on it, and the author was told nothing. It opened this finding under rule R2, so the post is frozen as after any such finding: korbat keeps its images, also against the author's deletion, until an admin has answered, and the urgent alert went out. A similar fingerprint can be made on purpose for a harmless image. Only an admin answers: seal for good, or answer without a seal, without seeing the images.",
    /** [case.matchFlag]. */
    flag: "This match is a flag and nothing more: the source does not class the entry as child sexual abuse material. The program refused, sealed and froze nothing and cited no rule, nobody was alerted, and the author was told nothing. Decide the case on what you can read: this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. If they give you a ground of your own, decide on that rule or the law; if they do not, decide that nothing breaks a rule, which answers the flag.",
    /** [case.matchWhat], under either. */
    what: "What a match shows: a file has the same, or a similar, fingerprint as one that the source classified. It does not show what the image is. Nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, before an answer or after it. Decide as for a report: on this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. Never write that the image is child sexual abuse material or that korbat confirmed it.",
  },
  /** [case.image.matched] (8.4). */
  imageMatched: IMAGE_MATCHED,
  /** [case.autoR2] (8.4), for a program's seal of a post's images. */
  caseAutoR2:
    "Only an admin answers a seal: seal for good, or answer without a seal. You answer without seeing the images, and nobody at korbat opens them afterwards either. An answer without a seal puts them before everyone again: it needs one of the reasons below.",
  /** [case.liftedMatch] (8.4), in the place of 3c's sentence after an answer without a seal, on a case that holds a match. */
  liftedMatch: "After an answer without a seal the images are served again as before. They stay closed to staff: nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, on this case or on any other. No person will have looked at them.",
  /** [case.autoRecord]'s second sentence, for an admin who restricts on a match's finding citing R2. */
  caseAutoRecordPartly: "It is recorded as taken partly by automated means: you cannot view the images, so the comparison is a fact your decision rests on.",
  /** The reason an answer without a seal on an acting match asks for, before the key (8.4). */
  answerReason: { legend: "The reason of this answer without a seal", choose: "Choose the reason of this answer without a seal: it is part of what your key signs." },
  /** [restore.program] (8.7), beside a gap whose lost row is a program's decision. */
  restoreProgram: "A program took this measure, not a person. Take it again as your own decision while you decide; the author is sent your decision's statement.",
} as const;

 * every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. An authority's reference and a leave's are

export const RELEASE_WORDS = {
  title: "Release",

  facts: {

    theirReference: { label: "The authority's reference", frame: "As recorded from the authority", none: "not recorded" },
    answer: {
      label: "The authority's assessment",
      values: { illegal: "illegal", not_illegal: "not illegal", no_assessment: "no assessment", other: "another answer" } as Record<string, string>,

    },
    answeredAt: { label: "Assessed on", none: "no answer" },
    handedOverAt: { label: "Files handed over on", none: "nothing was handed over" },
    leave: { label: "Leave or instruction to destroy", none: "none recorded", from: { authority: "from the authority", court: "from a court" } as Record<string, string> },
    leaveReference: { label: "Its reference", none: "none recorded" },
    leaveDay: { label: "Its day", none: "none recorded" },
    tell: {
      label: "The author may be told",
      atOnce: "at once",
      untold: (until: string | null) => `not yet: the leave is recorded as not to be told to the person, ${until === null ? "with no end recorded" : `until ${until}`}`,
      record: "not yet: the record of the report, or an authority's order about one of these posts, says that the person is not to be told",
    },
    quarantined: { label: "Files in the quarantine", yes: "all of them, by the record", no: "not all: the move is not recorded" },
    preserved: { label: "Preserved for an order", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
  },
  what: "A release ends korbat's keeping of these sealed images for good. It marks the posts as released and erases their image rows now. Whoever has the server then destroys the files in the quarantine, and the digest of each destroyed file is recorded as the proof. It cannot be undone: nothing brings a destroyed file back. The seal stays in the record as a measure, and the post's text is not touched.",
  tells:
    `The author is told what korbat did: that it released the images, and that an authority's or a court's leave or instruction is its ground. The notice names no authority and no reference and says nothing of what any authority found. If an authority has asked korbat not to tell the person and the line above still reads "at once", do not release: whoever has the server records the authority's request first (with the leave when the leave is recorded, staff.js release-leave --untold; for a leave that is recorded already, notification-event on the record of the report).`,
  backups: (backupDays: number) =>
    `A backup of the image store taken before the files moved may still hold them: korbat's backups are deleted ${backupDays} days after they were taken, except a backup kept for an authority, which is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups).   leave: (from: string) => `Ground: leave to destroy. The record holds a leave or an instruction to destroy these images, ${from}, of the day and with the reference shown above.`,
  assessed:
    "The authority assessed these images as illegal. An assessment is not leave to destroy: it is a reason an authority may want them kept. The images stay sealed and kept until the authority or a court gives korbat leave or an instruction to destroy them and whoever has the server has recorded it (staff.js release-leave).",
  notIllegal:
    "The authority answered that the images are not illegal. That is no ground for a release. Lift the seal instead (Correct this decision, Lift the seal): the images are shown again once their files are returned.",
  conflict:
    'The record holds an assessment "not illegal" and a leave to destroy. The two do not fit. Ask whoever has the server which is wrong before you do either: lifting the seal returns the images, a release destroys them.',
  nothing: "This ends nothing by itself. The images stay sealed and kept.",
  periodUnset: "korbat has set no period after which sealed images are released when an authority stays silent. Until counsel has set one and the terms publish it, nothing is released by time.",
  more: (max: number, remaining: number) =>
    `This seal lists more posts than one confirmation can release. This one releases the first ${max} of them, in the order of their ids; ${remaining} more remain. Read the case again and confirm again for the rest.`,
  sign: (posts: number) => `You confirm with your staff key: this seal, its ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, the ground, and the leave with its reference as shown above.`,
  done: (releasedAt: string, posts: number, images: number, filesLeft: number, held: boolean, backupsClearAt: string) =>
    `Released at ${releasedAt}: ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, ${images} ${images === 1 ? "image row" : "image rows"} erased. Files left to destroy: ${filesLeft}. They are in the quarantine until whoever has the server destroys them (the README, Quarantine), and every staff account is alerted daily while one is still recorded there. export const RECOVERY_WORDS = {

  // Home (8.2).
  homeCopy: (days: number) => `The copy is ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} old. The keeper downloads the audit log's tail on the daily visit: Audit log, "Download since my last copy".`,
  /** [home.copy] before any copy was taken: the design's sentence has no age to print then. */
  homeCopyNone: `No copy of the audit log's tail has been taken yet. The keeper downloads it on the daily visit: Audit log, "Download since my last copy".`,
  homeRestore: (open: number, measures: number) =>
    `After a restore: ${open} ${open === 1 ? "gap is" : "gaps are"} open, ${measures} of them measures to take again. Keep the app's site closed (APP_SITE=closed, Caddy recreated) until every order disabling and seal among them is back.`,
  // After a restore (8.8).
  title: "After a restore",
  what: "The database was restored from a backup, and the keeper's copy names what the backup lacks. Nothing below is in force until a person takes it again under a key: korbat imports no measure. Work from the top.",
  // 3f's review (operations1): the operator's step closes the site, which korbat cannot see; the screen says what to keep.
  site: "Keep the app's site closed (APP_SITE=closed, Caddy recreated) until no order disabling and no seal is open here.",
  siteOpen: "No order disabling and no seal is open. The operator may open the app's site (APP_SITE=open, Caddy recreated).",
  retention: "No measure is open. The operator may switch retention and the image sweep back on.",
  lost: "What no import brings back: the texts of the lost decisions, everything after the keeper's last download, and anything the keeper's files do not hold (the import printed every place it found missing in them). For those, the contact-point mailbox and the operator's notes are the record.",
  holds:
    "Before you disable anything again for an order: whoever has the server compares each held notice below with the contact-point mailbox since the keeper's last download.   holdUntil: (until: string | null) => (until === null ? "Held with no end recorded" : `Held until ${until}`),
  importedAt: (at: string) => `The newest import ran at ${at}.`,
  nothingOpen: "Every gap is closed.",
  classes: {

    seal_final: { heading: "Seals for good", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a seal for good, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    seal_interim: { heading: "Seals taken while deciding", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a seal taken while deciding, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    standing: { heading: "Suspensions and terminations", line: (measure: string, actedAt: string) => `Lost: ${measure}, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    restriction: { heading: "Other restrictions", line: (measure: string, actedAt: string) => `Lost: ${measure}, decided at ${actedAt}.` },
    reversal: { heading: "Reversals", line: (actedAt: string) => `Lost: a reversal, decided at ${actedAt}.` },

    release: {

          : action === "release_leave_withdrawn"

      holdLine: (actedAt: string, endAs: "report" | "no_report") =>
        `Lost: the end of a held upload's hold, of ${actedAt}, as ${endAs === "report" ? "Report" : "No report"}. The database again shows the hold as open, or does not hold the refusal at all.`,
      /** [restore.holdEnd]: when the refusal is there, beside a link to Held uploads; when it is gone, in place of a control. */
      holdEnd: (present: boolean) =>
        present
          ? "End this hold again the same way; your key closes this gap. Do not run upload-report a second time: whoever has the server checks the keeper's files for the record of the report first."

    },
    record: {
      heading: "Records to enter again",
      line: (actedAt: string, what: string) =>
        `Lost: a record of ${actedAt} that the copy names and cannot write again (${what}). Whoever has the server enters it again from the authority's letters and their own notes, with the command that wrote it, naming this gap (--gap).`,

  /** {what} of a gap of the class record: the words of its lost row's action. */
  recordWhat: (action: string) =>
    action === "notification_recorded"

      : action === "production_recorded"
        ? "a production to an authority"
        : action === "preserved_accessed"
          ? "an access to preserved content for an authority"
          : "a record",
  orderLine: "Open the order, then Disable for an order: the preservation's end, the hold and the clock keep their imported values. Read the held notices above first.",
  openOrder: "Open the order",
  openCase: "Open the case",
  noTarget: "The restored database no longer holds what this names.",
  notNeeded: "Not needed",
  notNeededWhat: "Use this when the measure had ended, or was reversed, before the restore, or when the target no longer exists. It is recorded with your key and cannot be undone here.",
  notNeededDone: "Closed as not needed.",
  closed: (disposition: "reapplied" | "not_needed" | "imported", at: string) =>
    `${disposition === "reapplied" ? "Taken again" : disposition === "not_needed" ? "Not needed" : "Entered again"} at ${at}.`,
  /** 3d Task 2 [restore.sealAgain] (8.7): beside a lost seal for good whose post is released. */
  sealAgain: "This seal's post was released. Take the seal again all the same, so that the record is whole: it freezes nothing and brings nothing back.",
  /** [restore.again] (8.8): the composer's line when a decision takes a lost one again. */
  again: (actedAt: string) => `This takes again a decision of ${actedAt} that was lost with a restore. Its statement says so. Write the facts and the reason again: the lost texts are gone.`,
  /** [effect.preserve] for a disabling taken again after a restore (8.5): the end it had stays. */
  effectPreserveAgain: (preserveUntil: string) => `Each post, its images and a copy of its text are preserved until ${preserveUntil}, as before the restore.`,

/**

 * was typed into. They stand here with every other word for a refusal, so that no screen keeps a table of its own.
 */

  not_found: "No case has this address.",

/** The reveal, once the key confirmed it: the day's limit on reveals. */
export const REVEAL_WORDS = { rate_limited: "You have revealed as many sources as one staff account may in a day. You can reveal others after midnight UTC." };

/** Saving a text, a note or a reveal's reason alike: the limit of saves a minute. */
export const NOTE_WORDS = { rate_limited: "Too many texts were saved in a minute. Wait a moment and save again." };

/** "Open a case" on the queue screen: a link that names nothing live, the day's limit on findings, and a link that is none. */
export const FINDING_WORDS = {
  not_found: "That link names nothing live on korbat: the post or the account does not exist or was deleted.",
  rate_limited: "You have opened as many findings as one staff account may in a day. You can open others after midnight UTC.",
  invalid_request: "Give a link to a post or a profile on korbat.",
};

  restricted_rule: "restricted under a rule",
  restricted_legal: "restricted as illegal",
  no_violation: "no breach found",
  not_evident: "illegality not evident",
  not_available: "nothing live at the link",
  partly_reversed: "restriction reversed in part",
  reversed: "restriction reversed",

/** The four kinds of decision, as the case page and its history name them. */
export const DECISION_KINDS: Record<CaseDecision["kind"], string> = {
  interim: "While deciding",
  final: "Final decision",
  // 3f (design, section 8.6).

  mayNotReview: "You may not review it: a reviewer made none of the case's decisions, opened no finding in it, and is not close to anyone in it.",
  needsAdmin: "Its review is an admin's.",
  reviewer: {
    available: "A reviewer is available.",
    none_single_staff: "It has no possible reviewer now: korbat has one staff account that could review it, and that one took part in the case.",
    none_eligible: "It has no possible reviewer now: every staff account that could review it took part in the case or is close to someone in it.",
  } satisfies Record<ReviewerState, string>,
  statementOnCase: "What the appellant wrote is read on the case's page.",
  reviewerRule: "Appeals need a reviewer who made none of the case's decisions and opened no finding in it.",
  reviewLabel: "Review this appeal",
  notYours: "This appeal is answered, or is not yours to review.",
} as const;

/** What a decision that lifted the protection of reported images did, as the home screen's list words it. */
export const PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS: Record<"unsealed" | "dismissed", string> = {
  unsealed: "Lifted a seal",
  dismissed: "Answered a report of child sexual abuse material without a seal",
};

/** The two kinds of decision the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_KINDS: Record<"interim" | "final", string> = {
  interim: "While deciding",
  final: "Decide the case",
};

/** The three outcomes the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_OUTCOMES: Record<"restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident", string> = {
  restricted: "Restrict",
  no_violation: "No breach",
  not_evident: "Illegality not evident",
};

/**
 * The composer's sentences beside its texts and its preview. The rule on personal data is the design's sentence in three
 * parts, so that each part is written once: the rule itself, and where the text goes, which differs for a decision
 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { OrderNoticeFacts, OrderTexts, STANDING_RULES, type Platform } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { AccountExport } from "../../auth";
import type { ModerationExport } from "../../moderation";
import type { ProfileExport } from "../../social";
import { AccountError, type AccountDeps } from "../context";
import type { OpenFile, ZipWriter } from "../zip";

/** One export a day (1b design, section 10). */
export const EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW = 1;
export const EXPORT_WINDOW_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const exportLimitKey = (userId: string) => `export:${userId}`;

/** The entry an image has in the archive; export.json names it under the post's media. */
export function mediaEntry(id: string): string {
  return `media/${id}.webp`;
}

/** The download's name: the handle and the day, so several exports of one account sort by date. */
export function exportFilename(handle: string, now: Date): string {
  return `korbat-export-${handle}-${now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip`;
}

/**
 * What the archive is written from. The account's own facts, the profile and the moderation member are
 * read before the first byte; the profile's lists are read page by page while export.json is written,
 * and the images, each behind the media module's checked open, go first, so `missingMedia` is complete
 * by the time the JSON that lists it is written.
 */
export interface ExportPlan {
  exportedAt: Date;
  /** The handle of the session that asked for the export: the id the auth module lists each session under. */
  currentSession: string;
  account: AccountExport;
  profile: ProfileExport;
  /** The decisions about the account that it was told of and its own reports, as the moderation module hands them over (3c design, section 7.11). */
  moderation: ModerationExport;
  images: { id: string; open: OpenFile }[];
  /** The images whose file the checked open refused or could not find, filled while the images are written. */
  missingMedia: string[];
}

/**
 * Counts one export of the account in the daily window and refuses once it is used up. Taken before
 * anything is built or streamed, so a stream that fails midway still counts; Retry-After says when the
 * window resets.
 */
export async function enforceExportLimit(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  let hit: { count: number; resetMs: number };
  try {
    hit = await deps.limits.hit(exportLimitKey(userId), EXPORT_WINDOW_MS);
  } catch {
    // Fails closed: an export that cannot be counted is not made, and the client is told to retry shortly.
    throw new AccountError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
  }
  if (hit.count > EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW) throw new AccountError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hit.resetMs / 1000)));
}

/**
 * Gives the day's export back after a failure before the archive's first byte (a pool timeout, a
 * restart): the owner received nothing, so the attempt must not use up the day. Best effort: when the
 * store cannot be reached, the export stays counted and a warning says so, which costs the owner a day
 * at worst.
 */
export async function giveBackExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, log: Logger): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await deps.limits.release(exportLimitKey(userId));
  } catch (err) {
    log.warn({ err, userId }, "account export: the day's export could not be given back after a failure before the first byte");
  }
}

const iso = (at: Date): string => at.toISOString();
const isoOrNull = (at: Date | null): string | null => (at ? at.toISOString() : null);

/**
 * What an account module built without the moderation module writes: the member is part of the format, so it is always
 * there. Its reporting counts are empty over the standing rules' frame, the number the moderation module would read.
 */
const NO_MODERATION: ModerationExport = {
  decisions: [],
  reports: [],
  strikes: [],
  standing: [],
  replies: [],
  reporting: { frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 },
  uploads: [],
  releases: [],
};

/**
 * Reads what is needed before the first byte: the account's facts, sessions, devices and events (one
 * read, bounded by the 90 days of events), the profile's own fields, the list of images, and the
 * moderation member (the decisions the account was told of and its own reports, both short lists). The
 * four modules are asked at once, so a read that fails costs the owner nothing: no byte was sent yet.
 * `currentSession` is the handle of the session asking, which marks its entry among the sessions.
 * `pageSize` is how many rows of each profile list are read at a time; tests lower it.

export async function buildExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, currentSession: string, now: Date, pageSize?: number): Promise<ExportPlan> {
  const [account, profile, images, moderation] = await Promise.all([

    deps.social.exportProfile(userId, pageSize),

/** A list member of export.json, read in pages and written one element at a time. */
class Paged<T> {
  constructor(
    readonly pages: AsyncIterable<readonly T[]>,
    readonly element: (row: T) => unknown,
  ) {}
}

/** An array already in memory, as one page. */
function inMemory<T>(rows: readonly T[], element: (row: T) => unknown): Paged<T> {
  return new Paged(
    (async function* () {
      yield rows;
    })(),
    element,
  );
}

/** Fragments are gathered into pieces of about this many UTF-16 units, at most 3 bytes each in UTF-8: well under 64 KiB. */
const PIECE_CHARS = 16 * 1024;

/**
 * export.json in pieces, written exactly as JSON.stringify(document, null, 2) writes the whole
 * document: member by member at the top level, and the lists element by element, each element
 * stringified on its own and indented to its depth (JSON.stringify's output holds line breaks only
 * between tokens; one inside a string is escaped, so indenting after every line break is exact). No list
 * is ever whole in memory: each is read page by page as it is written.
 */
export async function* exportJson(plan: ExportPlan): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let buffer = "";
  for await (const fragment of documentFragments(plan)) {
    buffer += fragment;
    if (buffer.length >= PIECE_CHARS) {
      yield buffer;
      buffer = "";
    }
  }
  if (buffer.length > 0) yield buffer;
}

function inShapeOrder<T extends object>(shape: object, value: T): T {

/** The moderation member with every entry's members in the order of the format (ExportFormat in the contracts). */
function moderationMember(moderation: ModerationExport): ModerationExport {

    })),
    // 3e (W.8): the strikes the account was given.
    strikes: moderation.strikes.map((strike) => ({ decisionId: strike.decisionId, postId: strike.postId, ruleId: strike.ruleId, givenAt: strike.givenAt, countsUntil: strike.countsUntil, overruledAt: strike.overruledAt })),
    // Then its suspensions, terminations and reporting measures, its replies to them, and its own reporting counts.
    standing: moderation.standing.map((entry) => ({
      decisionId: entry.decisionId,
      kind: entry.kind,
      basis: entry.basis,
      days: entry.days,
      announced: entry.announced,
      decidedAt: entry.decidedAt,
      earliestStart: entry.earliestStart,
      startsAt: entry.startsAt,
      endsAt: entry.endsAt,
      liftedAt: entry.liftedAt,
      liftedBy: entry.liftedBy,
      replaced: entry.replaced,
      basisEndedAt: entry.basisEndedAt,
      basisEndedBy: entry.basisEndedBy,
    })),
    replies: moderation.replies.map((reply) => ({ decisionId: reply.decisionId, filedAt: reply.filedAt, onTime: reply.onTime, text: reply.text, erasedAt: reply.erasedAt, answeredAt: reply.answeredAt, answeredBy: reply.answeredBy })),
    reporting: {
      frameDays: moderation.reporting.frameDays,
      days: moderation.reporting.days.map((entry) => ({ day: entry.day, reports: entry.reports })),
      marks: moderation.reporting.marks.map((mark) => ({ ref: mark.ref, position: mark.position, sentOn: mark.sentOn, markedAt: mark.markedAt, withdrawnAt: mark.withdrawnAt, counts: mark.counts })),
      markedReports: moderation.reporting.markedReports,
    },
    // 3d (W.10): the refused uploads as their notices read them, and the releases the account may be told of.
    uploads: moderation.uploads.map((upload) => ({

      refusedAt: upload.refusedAt,
      source: upload.source,
      matchKind: upload.matchKind,
      listedAs: upload.listedAs,
      objection: upload.objection === null ? null : { text: upload.objection.text, objectedAt: upload.objection.objectedAt },
      mayObject: upload.mayObject,
      endedAt: upload.endedAt,
      endAs: upload.endAs,
      endReason: upload.endReason,
      released: upload.released,
      reportKept: upload.reportKept,

/** A top-level member's array, as JSON.stringify writes it at that depth: "[]" when empty, else one element per line group. */
async function* listFragments<T>(list: Paged<T>): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let first = true;
  for await (const page of list.pages) {
    for (const row of page) {
      yield `${first ? "[\n" : ",\n"}    ${indented(JSON.stringify(list.element(row), null, 2), "    ")}`;
      first = false;
    }
  }
  yield first ? "[]" : "\n  ]";
}

const indented = (json: string, pad: string): string => json.replaceAll("\n", `\n${pad}`);

/**
 * Writes the archive: every image as a stored entry, then export.json, then the central directory.
 * export.json comes last so that missingMedia can name every image whose file the checked open refused
 * or did not find when its turn came (the sweeper may be between the row and the file), or that was no
 * longer the owner's to export by then: the media module reads each image's row again as it opens the
 * file, and opens none for an image deleted with its post, erased or sealed since the list was read.
 * The order of entries means nothing to a reader.
 */
export async function writeExport(writer: ZipWriter, plan: ExportPlan): Promise<void> {
  for (const image of plan.images) {
    if (!(await writer.addFile(mediaEntry(image.id), image.open))) plan.missingMedia.push(image.id);
  }
  await writer.addJsonPieces("export.json", exportJson(plan));
  await writer.end();
}

 */
export type DecisionMessage =
  | { template: "moderation_decision"; subject: DecisionMailSubject; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: an announced measure, with its days (null for a termination), the reply window in hours and the earliest start.
  | { template: "suspension_announced"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; window: number; earliestStart: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_started_at_once"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; endsAt: string | null; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: the answer to the person's reply, which kept the measure in force or reversed it.
  | { template: "reply_answered"; outcome: "kept" | "reversed"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "lifted" | "basis"; period: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: a withdrawal signed `replaced`, with the withdrawn decision's time and whether the person had replied to it.
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "replaced"; decidedAt: string; replied: boolean; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 5: a warning about the account's reports; a restriction of them, with its days and its end.
  | { template: "reporting_warned"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "reporting_restricted"; days: number; endsAt: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3f Task 3 (design, W.5): an order's notice, a reinstatement after one, and the authority's words added to a notice
  // already told. Each says only that a notice is there or has grown: its paragraphs are not mailed, and are empty.
  | { template: "order_notice" | "order_reinstated_notice" | "order_notice_added"; paragraphs: readonly string[] };

/** The templates of a decision's statement mail: a stop of the address never holds one back. */
const DECISION_TEMPLATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "moderation_decision",
  "suspension_announced",
  "suspension_started_at_once",
  "reply_answered",
  "suspension_lifted",
  "reporting_warned",
  "reporting_restricted",
  "order_notice",
  "order_reinstated_notice",
  "order_notice_added",
]);

/** Whether an account's message is a decision's statement. */
const isDecisionMessage = (message: { template: string }): message is DecisionMessage => DECISION_TEMPLATES.has(message.template);

/** What the statement's paragraphs are joined with in a mail's data: one paragraph per line. */
const LINE_BREAK = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A decision's message as its template's flat data: one data value for the statement, one paragraph per line, exactly as it was rendered. */
function decisionData(message: DecisionMessage): Record<string, string> {
  const statement = message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK);
  switch (message.template) {
    case "moderation_decision":
      return { subject: message.subject, statement };
    case "suspension_announced":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, window: String(message.window), earliestStart: noticeTime(new Date(message.earliestStart)), ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }) };
    case "suspension_started_at_once":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }), ...(message.endsAt === null ? {} : { endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) }) };
    case "reply_answered":
      return { outcome: message.outcome, statement };
    case "suspension_lifted":
      return message.why === "replaced"
        ? { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, decidedAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.decidedAt)), replied: String(message.replied), statement }
        : { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, period: message.period, statement };
    case "reporting_warned":
      return { statement };
    case "reporting_restricted":
      return { statement, days: String(message.days), endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) };
    case "order_notice":
    case "order_reinstated_notice":
    case "order_notice_added":
      // A fixed body: nothing of the notice goes by mail.
      return {};
  }
}

/** What may be sent to a signed-out notifier's contact by itself: the receipt. Its updates go by address, through mailNotifierUpdates. */
export type NotifierMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage;
/**
 * 3d (design, sections 7.1 and 7.15; W.8): the notice that korbat lost the files of an image of the account's post while
 * they were kept apart in the quarantine, with the post's creation time. No stop of the address holds it back: it is no
 * mail about the account's reports.
 */
export interface ImageLostMessage {
  template: "image_lost";
  postCreatedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2 and 7.15; W.6 and W.8): the author's notice of a release of sealed images of their
 * posts, with the view its paragraphs are rendered from: the ground, the times, the posts' times and the counts, never an
 * authority, a reference or an assessment. No stop of the address holds it back: it is about the account's own posts.
 */
export interface ReleaseNoticeMessage {
  template: "release_notice";
  view: ReleaseNoticeView;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 7.12, 7.15; W.5 and W.8): the uploader's two notices of a refused upload, each with the
 * notice's paragraphs as rendered for the app's screen (uploadNoticeParagraphs): `upload_refused` after the refusal's
 * commit, and `upload_hold_lifted` once a hold ended as no_report has passed its delay, with the paragraph of that end. No
 * stop of the address holds either back: each is about the account's own upload.
 */
export interface UploadNoticeMessage {
  template: "upload_refused" | "upload_hold_lifted";
  paragraphs: readonly string[];
}

/** What may be sent to an account: the receipt and the daily update of its reports, the statement of a decision about it, and (3d) the notices of a lost image, of a release and of a refused upload. */
export type AccountMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage | AccountUpdateMessage | DecisionMessage | ImageLostMessage | ReleaseNoticeMessage | UploadNoticeMessage;

/** One contact's share of the daily update: the lines of its notice, and its receipt when the 24-hour cap folded it. */
export interface NotifierUpdatePart {
  contactId: string;
  /** The reference of the contact's notice. */
  ref: string;
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
  receipt?: { ref: string; receivedAt: Date; items: readonly string[] };
}

/** What became of one contact's share: as a mail's result, or "unavailable" when the relay could not take that address's mail or the contact could not be read. */
export type NotifierUpdateResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused" | "unavailable";

/**
 * The staff alerts: counts, times and a staff account's public handle, never a link or content. The urgent lane's alert;
 * the cases that wait longer than their lane's response time, and those that hold a measure taken while deciding for
 * more than a day; the staff account that confirmed many decisions in a short time; the one that reached its daily case
 * limit; every reveal of who sent a report, with the day's count; and every decision that lifted the protection of
 * images reported as child sexual abuse material.
 */
export type StaffMessage =
  | StaffAlertMessage
  // 3f's review (people4): `phones`, whether the phone alerts are on (NOTIFY), so the mail never says a push went to a
  // phone when nothing publishes one, and says instead that it is the only alert.
  // 3d Task 7 (W.7): `heldUploads`, the held uploads that wait for an admin or hold an unanswered objection, which the
  // mail prints as a second sentence when it is above zero; `count` and `oldest` include them.
  // 3d review L8: `count` is the lane's cases alone and `oldest` the oldest case's, null when no case waits and the alert
  // is for held uploads alone.
  | { template: "moderation_urgent"; count: number; oldest: Date | null; phones: boolean; heldUploads?: number }
  | { template: "moderation_waiting"; lanes: readonly { lane: 0 | 1 | 2; count: number; oldest: Date }[]; interim: number; replies?: { count: number; oldest: Date } | null; phones: boolean }
  | { template: "moderation_burst"; handle: string; count: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reads"; handle: string; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reveal"; handle: string; at: Date; count: number; limit: number }
  // 3d Task 7 (7.11 step 6, W.8): `matched` on a case whose finding came from a match: the variant that says the images
  // stay closed to staff. It carries no reason: the reason is on the decision, where the console shows it.
  | { template: "moderation_csam_lifted"; handle: string; at: Date; what: "unsealed" | "dismissed"; matched?: true };

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 7.2, 7.19 and 18, W.4): the staff alerts whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick
 * mails from a row of alert_outbox: the row's facts, counts and times only, and nothing else. Later tasks of 3f add their
 * kinds here as they first write them.
 */
export type StaffAlertKind =
  | "contact_mail"
  | "contact_mail_escalated"
  | "order_due"
  | "mailbox_unreachable"
  | "alert_channel_down"
  | "order_opened"
  | "order_corrected"
  | "order_unverified"
  // Task 3: an order given effect, an order's measure lifted, and a held notice about to be released.
  | "order_effected"
  | "order_reinstated"
  | "hold_ending"
  // Task 6: the copy of the audit log's tail is overdue, and someone who did not take the last copy took one.
  | "copy_overdue"
  | "copy_taken"
  // Task 5's two daily kinds, joined in 3f's review: a report to an authority owed, a hand-over's copy not destroyed.
  | "report_owed"
  | "handover_undestroyed"
  // 3d Task 1: a move of sealed files that is due, which alert_steps() writes daily, and files the quarantine's record
  // says are lost, which staff.js quarantine-record writes with its record.
  | "quarantine_due"
  | "quarantine_lost"
  // 3d Task 2: a released file still recorded in the quarantine, which alert_steps() writes daily, and an admin's release
  // of sealed images, which staffAlert writes after the release's commit.
  | "release_undestroyed"
  | "seal_released"
  // 3d Task 3: the edge's job gave up on purges, which it writes as its own row of the outbox.
  | "edge_purge_failed"
  // 3d Task 5: the transparency job published a day's value without an outside timestamp, or found the day before
  // without a published value, each written as the job's own row of the outbox.
  | "head_unwitnessed"
  | "head_missed"
  // 3d Task 6: an author asked for a person, and a cap or a limit refused a program's measure, each written by staffAlert
  // after its commit; a request for a person waited longer than its target, the automated sweep's own row.
  | "automated_objection"
  | "automation_capped"
  | "automated_waiting"
  // 3d Task 7: the comparison of uploads needs the operator (alert_steps() daily, and staffAlert at once over the limit on
  // refusals), and a held upload's hold ended without a report (staffAlert after the end's commit).
  | "matcher_down"
  | "hold_ended_unreported"
  // 3d review M13: a day's value whose keeper's mail never went out, the transparency job's own row in the next day's
  // first round.
  | "head_unmailed";
export interface StaffAlertMessage {
  template: StaffAlertKind;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

/**
 * A staff alert's template data: every member as the text the template prints. A 3f alert's facts go as they are, each
 * count as its digits, with the time it is sent: the template prints a time with its day only when that is not today's.
 */
function staffData(message: StaffMessage, now: Date): Record<string, string> {
  switch (message.template) {
    case "contact_mail":
    case "contact_mail_escalated":
    case "order_due":
    case "mailbox_unreachable":
    case "alert_channel_down":
    case "order_opened":
    case "order_corrected":
    case "order_unverified":
    case "order_effected":
    case "order_reinstated":
    case "hold_ending":
    case "copy_overdue":
    case "copy_taken":
    case "report_owed":
    case "handover_undestroyed":
    case "quarantine_due":
    case "quarantine_lost":
    case "release_undestroyed":
    case "seal_released":
    case "edge_purge_failed":
    case "head_unwitnessed":
    case "head_missed":
    case "automated_objection":
    case "automation_capped":
    case "automated_waiting":
    case "matcher_down":
    case "hold_ended_unreported":
    case "head_unmailed":
      return { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(message.facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, String(value)])), now: now.toISOString() };
    case "moderation_urgent":
      return {
        count: String(message.count),
        ...(message.oldest === null ? {} : { oldest: noticeTime(message.oldest) }),
        phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off",
        ...(message.heldUploads ? { heldUploads: String(message.heldUploads) } : {}),
      };
    case "moderation_waiting": {
      // A lane's pair only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      const data: Record<string, string> = { phones: message.phones ? "on" : "off" };
      for (const lane of message.lanes) {
        if (lane.count <= 0) continue;
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Count`] = String(lane.count);
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Oldest`] = noticeTime(lane.oldest);
      }
      if (message.interim > 0) data.interimCount = String(message.interim);
      // 3e Task 4: the replies unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, only when there are any.
      if (message.replies && message.replies.count > 0) {
        data.replyCount = String(message.replies.count);
        data.replyOldest = noticeTime(message.replies.oldest);
      }
      return data;
    }
    case "moderation_burst":
      return { handle: message.handle, count: String(message.count) };
    case "moderation_csam_lifted":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), what: message.what, ...(message.matched ? { matched: "yes" } : {}) };
    case "moderation_reads":
      return { handle: message.handle, limit: String(message.limit) };
    case "moderation_reveal":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), count: String(message.count), limit: String(message.limit) };
  }
}

export type NotifierMailResult = "sent" | "folded" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused";
export type AccountMailResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "refused";

/** What staff may know of a signed-out notifier without a reveal: never the name or the address themselves. */
export interface NotifierFacts {
  /** False for an id no contact has: it was never stored, or the janitor has forgotten it. Then the other four are false too. */
  found: boolean;
  named: boolean;
  contactGiven: boolean;
  confirmed: boolean;
  suppressed: boolean;
}

/** A contact's ciphertexts open under the key, or under a key it replaced. Nothing read is ever written back under the newer key. */
const open = (deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "config">, payload: string): string => decrypt(payload, [deps.config.notifierKey, ...deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys]).toString("utf8");
const seal = (deps: AuthDeps, plain: string): string => encrypt(Buffer.from(plain, "utf8"), deps.config.notifierKey);

/** The same day `months` calendar months later in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes that month's last day. */
function monthsLater(at: Date, months: number): Date {
  const month = at.getUTCMonth() + months;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month, Math.min(at.getUTCDate(), lastDay), at.getUTCHours(), at.getUTCMinutes(), at.getUTCSeconds(), at.getUTCMilliseconds()));
}

/** The cap's marker for an address, by its keyed hash: set when a receipt goes to it unconfirmed, gone a day later. */
const receiptCapKey = (hash: string) => `notifier-receipt:${hash}`;

/** The receipt's template data. The page link is this module's: the status page's address with the contact's mail token in the fragment, which no server log sees. */
function receiptData(deps: AuthDeps, message: NoticeReceivedMessage, pageUrl?: string): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ref: message.ref,
    time: noticeTime(message.receivedAt),
    items: message.items.join(", "),
    ...(pageUrl === undefined ? {} : { pageUrl }),
    termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms`,
  };
}

/** Sends one mail. "refused" when the relay refused the recipient for good; any other failure is thrown, for the caller to try again. */
async function deliver(deps: AuthDeps, message: MailMessage): Promise<"sent" | "refused"> {
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send(message);
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof MailRefused) return "refused";
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Stores a signed-out notifier's contact under the id the moderation module wrote on the notice: the name and the
 * address normalised and encrypted under the notifier key, the address's keyed hash for the cap and for stops, and, with
 * an address, a fresh mail token encrypted beside it. A disposable address is taken: a notifier may want one. The contact
 * is forgotten 13 months on unless the notice is still owed something by then.
 */
export async function storeNotifierContact(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, contact: { name?: string; email?: string }): Promise<void> {
  const name = contact.name?.trim() || null;
  const email = contact.email?.trim().toLowerCase() || null;
  await deps.repo.createNotifierContact({
    id: contactId,
    nameEnc: name === null ? null : seal(deps, name),
    emailEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, email),
    emailHash: email === null ? null : emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email),
    // The token of the mails' link: it alone confirms or stops the address, so whoever typed someone else's address cannot.
    mailTokenEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, randomToken()),
    forgetAfter: monthsLater(deps.now(), RETENTION.contactMaxMonths),
  });
}

/**
 * Sends a signed-out notifier's receipt, under three rules. A stopped address gets nothing ("suppressed"). An address
 * that is not confirmed gets one receipt in 24 hours, and a further one is "folded": it rides in the next daily mail, so
 * typing someone's address into the form many times sends them one mail. A confirmed address has no cap. "forgotten"
 * when no contact has the id, "no_address" when the contact left none. A failure of the relay that is not about the
 * address is thrown, and gives the day's one receipt back first, so the retry is sent rather than folded.
 */
export async function mailNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, message: NotifierMessage): Promise<NotifierMailResult> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact) return "forgotten";
  if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) return "no_address";
  const hash = contact.emailHash;
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  // Opened before the cap is taken: a ciphertext no configured key opens throws here and spends nothing.
  const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
  const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${message.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
  const confirmed = (await deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes([hash], deps.now())).has(hash);
  if (!confirmed && !(await deps.kv.setIfAbsent(receiptCapKey(hash), "1", RECEIPT_CAP_MS))) return "folded";
  try {
    return await deliver(deps, { to, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message, pageUrl) });
  } catch (err) {
    if (!confirmed) await deps.kv.del(receiptCapKey(hash)).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "notifier receipt: the day's one receipt could not be given back after a failed send"));
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a mail to an account's own address, which its sign-in code confirmed: no cap and no confirmation. A stop of
 * that address applies to the two report mails, the receipt and the daily update, and never to a statement of reasons.
 * The update of an account is signed in: it carries its lines and neither a receipt nor a page link, since an account
 * follows its reports in the app. "no_address" for an account that is deleted or was never there.
 */
export async function mailAccount(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string, message: AccountMessage): Promise<AccountMailResult> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return "no_address";
  if (isDecisionMessage(message)) {
    // A statement is never held back by a stop of the address.
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: decisionData(message) });
  }
  // 3d: nor is the notice of a lost image, which is about the account's own post and not about its reports.
  if (message.template === "image_lost") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "image_lost", data: { createdAt: noticeTime(message.postCreatedAt) } });
  // 3d Task 2: nor is the notice of a release. Its paragraphs are rendered from these flat members by the template, from
  // the same function as the app's notice screen; the times go as ISO text and are printed as korbat's mails print them.
  if (message.template === "release_notice") {
    const view = message.view;
    return deliver(deps, {
      to: user.email,
      template: "release_notice",
      data: {
        basis: view.basis,
        releasedAt: view.releasedAt,
        backupsClearAt: view.backupsClearAt,
        upload: view.upload ? "yes" : "no",
        postCount: String(view.postCount),
        images: String(view.images),
        createdAt: view.posts[0]?.createdAt ?? "",
        appeal: view.appeal,
      },
    });
  }
  // 3d Task 7: nor are the notices of a refused upload, one paragraph per line, as the app's screen renders them.
  if (message.template === "upload_refused" || message.template === "upload_hold_lifted") {
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: { notice: message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK) } });
  }
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  if (message.template === "notice_update") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [...message.lines], receipts: [], pages: [] } });
  return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message as NoticeReceivedMessage) });
}

/**
 * The daily update to signed-out notifiers (3c design, sections 5 and 7.8): the parts are grouped by their contacts'
 * address, which only this module can see, and each address gets one notice_update with every part's lines, every
 * carried receipt with its page link, and the page link of each other notice it has a line for. A page link is the
 * status page's address with that contact's own mail token in the fragment, the same link its receipt carried.
 *
 * It applies a stop of the address, and neither the confirmation nor the 24-hour cap: nothing is withheld for want of a
 * confirmed address. It answers for each contact, and throws for none: an address whose mail the relay could not take is
 * "unavailable", so its lines stay pending while every other address's update is still sent. Each contact is read in a
 * try of its own: one that cannot be read (a ciphertext no configured key opens) is logged with its id, never an
 * address, and answered "unavailable" too.
 */
export async function mailNotifierUpdates(deps: AuthDeps, parts: readonly NotifierUpdatePart[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>> {
  const results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
  /** The readable parts, by their address's keyed hash, in the order given. */
  const byAddress = new Map<string, { to: string; parts: { part: NotifierUpdatePart; pageUrl: string }[] }>();
  for (const part of parts) {
    try {
      const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(part.contactId);
      if (!contact) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "forgotten");
        continue;
      }
      if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "no_address");
        continue;
      }
      if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([contact.emailHash])).has(contact.emailHash)) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "suppressed");
        continue;
      }
      const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
      const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${part.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
      const group = byAddress.get(contact.emailHash) ?? { to, parts: [] };
      group.parts.push({ part, pageUrl });
      byAddress.set(contact.emailHash, group);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, contactId: part.contactId }, "notifier update: the contact could not be read; its lines stay pending");
      results.set(part.contactId, "unavailable");
    }
  }
  for (const group of byAddress.values()) {
    const receipts = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt ? [{ ref: part.receipt.ref, time: noticeTime(part.receipt.receivedAt), items: part.receipt.items.join(", "), pageUrl }] : []));
    // A notice whose receipt rides in this update has its page with the receipt; every other notice with a line gets a page paragraph.
    const pages = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt || part.lines.length === 0 ? [] : [{ ref: part.ref, pageUrl }]));
    const lines = group.parts.flatMap(({ part }) => [...part.lines]);
    let result: NotifierUpdateResult;
    try {
      result = await deliver(deps, {
        to: group.to,
        template: "notice_update",
        data: { signedIn: false, lines, receipts, pages, ...(receipts.length > 0 ? { termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms` } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // The relay could not take this address's mail: the other addresses' mails still go. The contacts' ids, never the address.
      deps.log.warn({ err, contactIds: group.parts.map(({ part }) => part.contactId) }, "notifier update: not sent; its lines stay pending for the next round");
      result = "unavailable";
    }
    for (const { part } of group.parts) results.set(part.contactId, result);
  }
  // In the order the parts were given, whatever order the addresses were mailed in.
  return new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.contactId, results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"]));
}

/**
 * Sends a staff alert to every live staff account's address, best effort: a failed send is logged and never thrown, and
 * the answer is the number of addresses the relay took, 0 when it took none or there is no live staff account. It
 * applies no throttle: the moderation module keeps every throttle, as a key in the shared limit store.
 */
export async function mailStaff(deps: AuthDeps, message: StaffMessage): Promise<number> {
  const data = staffData(message, deps.now());
  let addresses: string[];
  try {
    addresses = await deps.repo.liveStaffAddresses();
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert: the staff accounts could not be read");
    return 0;
  }
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const to of addresses) {
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to, template: message.template, data });
      accepted++;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert email failed");
    }
  }
  return accepted;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 5 (design, sections 5, 7.7 and 18, W.8): the audit head's daily mail to the keeper, the copy that is not on
 * korbat's server: the day, the value, the place and the hash, from which the keeper computes the value again, and whether
 * an outside timestamp is stored. Typed like every message, so no caller passes free text.
 */
export interface KeeperMessage {
  template: "head_published";
  day: string;
  value: string;
  seq: number;
  hash: string;
  witnessed: boolean;
}

/** What became of the keeper's mail: sent, not sent while HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL is empty, refused by the relay, or failed. */
export type KeeperMailResult = "sent" | "off" | "refused" | "failed";

/**
 * Sends the keeper's daily mail to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL and to nobody else: the caller names no address, and none is read from
 * an account or a staff list. While the setting is empty it sends nothing ("off"). A failure is logged, without the
 * address, and answered, never thrown: the day's value stands published either way. 3d review M13: the transparency job
 * records a mail the relay accepted and sends one that failed again in the day's later rounds.
 */
export async function mailKeeper(deps: AuthDeps, message: KeeperMessage): Promise<KeeperMailResult> {
  const to = deps.config.keeperMail;
  if (to === null) return "off";
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send({
      to,
      template: "head_published",
      data: { day: message.day, value: message.value, seq: String(message.seq), hash: message.hash, witnessed: message.witnessed ? "stored" : "none" },
    });
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: "head_published", day: message.day }, "keeper's mail: not sent");
    return err instanceof MailRefused ? "refused" : "failed";
  }
}

/** For each id: whether a contact has it, whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped now. */
export async function notifierFacts(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierFacts>> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactFacts(contactIds);
  const hashes = rows.flatMap((row) => (row.emailHash === null ? [] : [row.emailHash]));
  const [confirmed, suppressed] = await Promise.all([deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes(hashes, deps.now()), deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes(hashes)]);
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  return new Map(
    contactIds.map((id): [string, NotifierFacts] => {
      const row = byId.get(id);
      if (!row) return [id, { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }];
      return [id, { found: true, named: row.named, contactGiven: row.contactGiven, confirmed: row.emailHash !== null && confirmed.has(row.emailHash), suppressed: row.emailHash !== null && suppressed.has(row.emailHash) }];
    }),
  );
}

/** The name a notifier gave, or null: for a confirmed reveal only. The address is never handed out. */
export async function notifierName(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  return contact?.nameEnc ? open(deps, contact.nameEnc) : null;
}

/** The contact's address hash when the token is its mail token, compared in constant time; null for anything else. */
async function addressOfToken(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact?.mailTokenEnc || !contact.emailHash) return null;
  let mailToken: string;
  try {
    mailToken = open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc);
  } catch (err) {
    // A contact no configured key opens matches nothing; the fault is the operator's to see, with the contact's id and no address.
    deps.log.error({ err, contactId }, "notifier contact: its mail token could not be decrypted");
    return null;
  }
  return safeEqual(mailToken, token) ? contact.emailHash : null;
}

/** Whether the token is the contact's mail token; false when the contact has none. */
export async function notifierMailTokenMatches(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token)) !== null;
}

/**
 * "I sent this": with the contact's mail token, records the address as confirmed for 30 days and lifts any stop of it.
 * False, and nothing done, for any other token: typing someone's address proves nothing about it.
 */
export async function confirmNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  const now = deps.now();
  await deps.repo.confirmNotifierAddress(hash, now, new Date(now.getTime() + RETENTION.confirmationDays * DAY));
  return true;
}

/** "Stop": with the contact's mail token, korbat sends this address no more mails about reports. Its notices are still processed. */
export async function stopNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  await deps.repo.suppressNotifierAddress(hash);
  return true;
}

/** Whether the account's address asked korbat to stop its report mails. */
export async function accountReportMailStopped(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  return (await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash);
}

/** Lifts a stop of the account's address, for the account's own Settings: the session proves the address. True when there was one. */
export async function resumeAccountReportMail(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  return deps.repo.liftNotifierSuppression(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email));
}

/** Moves the day these contacts are forgotten. */
export function forgetNotifierAfter(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[], at: Date): Promise<void> {
  return deps.repo.setNotifierForgetAfter(contactIds, at);
}

/** The contacts that gave this address, with the names they gave: for an access request from a signed-out notifier, from the command line only. */
export async function findNotifierContacts(deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "repo" | "config">, email: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactsByEmailHash(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email));
  return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, name: row.nameEnc ? open(deps, row.nameEnc) : null }));
}

/** How many contacts and confirmations the janitor should have removed more than a day ago: a count only, for the console's overview. */
export function overdueContacts(deps: AuthDeps): Promise<number> {
  return deps.repo.countNotifierRowsDue(new Date(deps.now().getTime() - DAY));
}
