});
export type CaseSignal = z.infer<typeof CaseSignal>;

export const CaseView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  lane: LaneNumber,
  stateVersion: Count,
  intakeSeq: Count,
  answeredSeq: Count,
  openedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  closedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  target: CaseTarget,
  suspicion: CaseSuspicion.nullable(),
  imagesAllowed: z.boolean(),
  snapshots: z.array(CaseSnapshot),
  items: z.array(CaseItem),
  decisions: z.array(CaseDecision),
  appeals: z.array(CaseAppeal),
  drafts: z.array(StaffTextDraft),
  notes: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  sealsDeclined: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  history: z.array(CaseHistoryEntry),
  // 3e (design, section 10.3): on a post case the strike's answer and the author's standing in bands, on an account case
  // the account's standing; each null on the other kind of case.
  strikeDue: StrikeDue.nullable(),
  authorStanding: AuthorStanding.nullable(),
  standing: CaseStanding.nullable(),
  /**
   * 3f (design, sections 8.6 and 10.2): `preserved` while the case's post is preserved for an order (post_preserved): the
   * page shows no image and no snapshot text, which the API withholds in any case; `noticeHeld` while an order's notice
   * about the case's post is held, with the hold's end (null while it has none recorded), so that the page and the
   * composer say that a decision taken now is told to its author only at the release; null when none is held.
   */
  preserved: z.boolean(),
  noticeHeld: z.object({ until: z.iso.datetime().nullable() }).nullable(),
  /**
   * Task 4 (section 8.6, [reinstate.erased]): the UTC day on which an order's preservation ended by erasing the case's
   * post, so the reinstatement's composer says that reinstating restores nothing; null on an account case and while no
   * erasure happened.
   */
  orderErasedOn: z.string().regex(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/, "must be a UTC day").nullable(),
  /**
   * Task 5 (sections 7.13 and 10.2): since when a report to the authorities is owed for this case, from reports_owed();
   * null when none is. The console learns nothing else of a notification record.
   */
  reportOwed: z.object({ since: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 3 (design, sections 7.4, 8.4 and 10.3): for each image the case's newest snapshot lists that stopped being
   * public, its newest outbox row of the edge: the purge's outcome, or pending, and its time. Empty on an account case,
   * while the newest snapshot is withheld, and for images that were never hidden.
   */
  purges: z.array(EdgePurgeView),
  /**
   * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.11, 8.4 and 10.3): one entry for each item of the case that a program opened: the item,
   * its signal's kind and, for a score, the version of the threshold it was over ([case.r1]); never the score, which beside
   * an image would read as a verdict. Task 7 adds a match's record.
   */
  signals: z.array(CaseSignal),
  /**
   * The author's request for a person about a program's measure that is in force on the case, with its time
   * ([case.objection]); null when none stands. The text is the author's, drawn framed.
   */
  objection: z.object({ text: z.string(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 7.11, 8 rule 2 and 10.3): the images of the case's snapshots that an unerased match record
   * names, which staff are never served, on this case or any other, also after an answer without a seal
   * ([case.image.matched]). A list beside the snapshots, so the members each snapshot's digest covers stay as they are.
   */
  matchedImages: z.array(z.uuid()),
  /**
   * 3d Task 8 (design, sections 7.13, 8.4 and 10.3): the flag "Possible coordinated reporting" ([case.flag]), the two
   * counts of case_flag while it answers true, else null. It is no finding: the case is decided on its content as always.
   */
  flag: CaseFlag.nullable(),
});
export type CaseView = z.infer<typeof CaseView>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the statement of reasons

/** A measure as a statement tells of it: what it was, the image of an image measure, whether it changed anything, and what a seal covers. */
export const StatementMeasure = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  /** Null when the measure changed what someone sees; `already` or `deleted` when it did not. */
  noEffect: z.enum(["already", "deleted"]).nullable(),
  /** For a seal: the posts and images its list held when it was recorded, and how many of those images were on posts their author had deleted by then. */
  sealed: z.object({ posts: Count, images: Count, deletedImages: Count }).nullable(),
  // 3e (design, section 10.2): what the ledger fixes for good about a measure of 3e, so a statement reads as it was sent.
  // Absent on 3c's measures.
  /** A strike's last moment of counting. */
  endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a strike: the account's strikes that stood and counted at the decision's time, this one included. */
  activeThen: Count.nullable().optional(),
  /** On a suspension or a termination: whether it was announced with the reply window or taken at once. */
  announced: z.boolean().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a retirement: the handle of the decision's snapshot, in lower case, as the database retires it. */
  handle: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a retirement that changed the profile: the placeholder the profile got; null when the measure changed nothing. */
  placeholder: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a suspension: its days, as the key signed them. */
  days: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).nullable().optional(),
  /** On a standing measure: what the database found it rests on. */
  basis: z.enum(STANDING_BASES).nullable().optional(),
  /** On a standing measure: its earliest start (the ledger row's starts_at), the decision's time for one taken at once. */
  earliestStart: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * On a standing measure: one entry for each decision it rests on, in the ledger's order, with its time, its rule and the
   * time of the post it was about; for a protective suspension the one entry is the sealing decision, with its time only.
   */
  restsOn: z.array(z.object({ decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(), ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(), postCreatedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() })).nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3e Task 5: on a restriction of reporting, the time of the warning it follows (its decision's), which its statement
   * names. A warning and a restriction also carry `basis` (`reports`) and `endsAt` (a warning's end of counting; a
   * restriction's start plus its days), and a restriction its `days`.
   */
  warnedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
});
export type StatementMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementMeasure>;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 10.2): where a suspension's or a termination's period stood at a decision's time, as the ledger
 * fixes it for good: not started, running since `startedAt`, or ended (from `startedAt` to `endedAt`). A member a state
 * does not need is null.
 */
export const PeriodThen = z.object({ state: z.enum(["not_started", "running", "ended"]), startedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(), endedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() });
export type PeriodThen = z.infer<typeof PeriodThen>;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 10.2): a standing measure (or a restriction of reporting) whose basis a reversal of this decision
 * broke: its kind and decision's time, where its period stood then, whether the basis that broke was a seal, and the time
 * of its reply when this decision found it unanswered and so answers it.
 */
export const StatementEndedStanding = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate", "restrict_reporting"]),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  periodThen: PeriodThen,
  seal: z.boolean(),
  replyFiledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
});
export type StatementEndedStanding = z.infer<typeof StatementEndedStanding>;

/**
 * What a statement says of a field reset that ended or was lifted: the decision that holds the reset (whose screen shows
 * the old value), whether korbat still kept that value when this decision was made, and the rule that decision cites,
 * since a value reset under R4 may have been erased by then.
 */
const ResetFacts = { resetDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(), oldValueKept: z.boolean(), resetRuleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable() };

/** A reversal as a statement tells of it. The reset's facts are set only on the lifting of a field reset. */
export const StatementReversal = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(REVERSAL_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  ...ResetFacts,
  /** 3e: on the reversal of a retirement, the handle it gives back, as the lifted decision's snapshot holds it, in lower case. */
  handle: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3e: on the lift of a suspension or a termination, the lifted measure's kind and its decision's time. Task 5: on the
   * lift of a reporting measure, the lifted warning's or restriction's kind and its decision's time too.
   */
  liftedKind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"]).nullable().optional(),
  liftedDecidedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3e: on such a lift, where the lifted measure's period stood at this decision's time. Task 5: on the lift of a
   * restriction of reporting, whether it still ran (`running`) or its days had run out (`ended`, with its end).
   */
  periodThen: PeriodThen.nullable().optional(),
  /** 3e: on such a lift, whether the correction withdrew an announced measure to make room for another (signed `replaced`). */
  replaced: z.boolean().nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3e Task 4: on such a lift, when the person had replied to the lifted measure, or null when they had not: a withdrawal
   * signed `replaced` then says that it is no decision on that reply.
   */
  replyFiledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
});
export type StatementReversal = z.infer<typeof StatementReversal>;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 10.2): on a correction or a review of the decision that holds a suspension or a termination, when it
 * kept or reversed that measure while the person's reply to it was unanswered (never a withdrawal signed `replaced`, never
 * the end of a broken basis): the reply's time and whether it came before the start; the measure's kind and days; where
 * its period stood at this answer's time; the start and the end as this answer fixes or leaves them (after a kept answer
 * to a reply before the start, the later of the answer and the earliest start; the end null for a termination; both null
 * when the measure never starts); and the last moment of the announcing decision's appeal as it stands after this answer.
 */
export const StatementRepliedTo = z.object({
  filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  onTime: z.boolean(),
  kind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate"]),
  days: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).nullable(),
  periodThen: PeriodThen,
  startsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime(),
});
export type StatementRepliedTo = z.infer<typeof StatementRepliedTo>;

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with the decision, without a reversal. The reset's facts are set only on a field reset. */
export const StatementEndedMeasure = z.object({ kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS), mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(), ...ResetFacts });
export type StatementEndedMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementEndedMeasure>;

/**
 * The statement's data (3c design, section 10): everything a statement of reasons is rendered from, and nothing a later
 * event changes, so a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered. It is the part of a decision that the
 * author's decision view, the console's preview and the mail share; @korbat/rules renders it (statementParagraphs).
 *   - `rulesVersion` and `redressVersion`: the rulebook and the redress texts the decision was made under.
 *   - `facts`, `reason`, `legalReference`: the staff texts, each null when the decision has none or it was erased.
 *   - `post`: the post a post case is about, by its id and creation time, which survive its deletion; null for an account case.
 *   - `endedMeasures`: the measures taken while deciding that ended with this decision. A seal taken while deciding is
 *     left out when the decision itself seals, since the images stay sealed.
 *   - `reviewed`: for a review or a correction, the decision it reviews, whose rule or law the statement renders
 *     under the rulebook version that decision was made under (`reviewed.rulesVersion`), never under its own.
 */
/** 3d Task 6: the three values of decisions.automated_decision, which its CHECK holds. */
export const AUTOMATED_DECISIONS = ["not_automated", "partially", "fully"] as const;
export type AutomatedDecision = (typeof AUTOMATED_DECISIONS)[number];

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and 10.2; W.3): the automated finding a statement speaks of. For a score: its kind,
 * and `viewed`, true when the person who decided opened the signal's image on this case before the decision and the
 * decision is not stored as unseen, false otherwise, null on a program's decision. For a match (Task 7): the source's
 * declared name, `matchKind` (exact only for a cryptographic hash's exact match, near for every perceptual match) and
 * `listedAs` (csam when the source itself lists the entry so). Null members are those its kind does not have.
 */
export const StatementSignal = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(SIGNAL_KINDS),
  source: z.string().max(100).nullable(),
  matchKind: z.enum(["exact", "near"]).nullable(),
  listedAs: z.enum(["csam", "other"]).nullable(),
  viewed: z.boolean().nullable(),
});
export type StatementSignal = z.infer<typeof StatementSignal>;

export const DecisionStatement = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(DECISION_KIND_VALUES),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  redressVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
  facts: z.string().nullable(),
  reason: z.string().nullable(),
  source: z.enum(DECISION_SOURCE_VALUES),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  measures: z.array(StatementMeasure),
  reversals: z.array(StatementReversal),
  endedMeasures: z.array(StatementEndedMeasure),
  /** 3e: the standing measures and restrictions of reporting whose basis a reversal of this decision broke; absent before 3e. */
  endedStanding: z.array(StatementEndedStanding).optional(),
  /** 3e Task 4: the reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing its measure; absent otherwise. */
  repliedTo: StatementRepliedTo.optional(),
  reviewed: z
    .object({
      kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "order"]),
      ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
      ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
      rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
      legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
      decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
      /**
       * 3e's review (people1): the basis of the reviewed decision's suspension or termination, null for a decision without
       * one; absent before 3e. A decision about a measure on the bases strikes, ladder_end or protective names korbat's
       * terms as what it rested on, never the rule it cited.
       */
      basis: z.enum(STANDING_BASES).nullable().optional(),
    })
    .nullable(),
  /**
   * 3f (design, section 10.4): for an order decision and the correction of one, what its notice is rendered from, built at
   * every read from the decision's row, its item's and the order's as they stand, so the notice grows without a new
   * decision; null (or absent) for every other decision.
   */
  order: OrderNoticeFacts.nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3f Task 6 (sections 7.17 step 7 and 10.4): for a decision that closed a restore gap, the UTC day of the lost decision
   * it took again, read from the gap, which is kept for as long as the decision; absent for every other decision.
   */
  reapplied: z.object({ lostOn: z.iso.date() }).nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3f's review (people3): the instant its author was told of the decision, the decision's informed_at: its own time for a
   * decision told at once, the release for one held with an order's notice, null while it is held; absent before the
   * review. The appeal's six months count from it, as appeal_deadline counts them in the database.
   */
  informedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and 10.2; W.3): what the decision's own columns say of automated means, and the
   * automated finding it rests on or considered. `automatedDetection` is true when a program's finding is among what the
   * decision considers (its reviewed decision's for a review or a correction); `automatedDecision` is fully for a
   * program's decision, partially for a restriction an admin took on a suspect program's finding under R2, and
   * not_automated otherwise. `signal` is that finding: its kind, and for a score whether the person who decided opened
   * the image on the case before deciding (`viewed`; null on a program's own decision). Absent, as on a decision made
   * before 3d, they read false, not_automated and null. No score, hash or list version is ever here.
   */
  automatedDetection: z.boolean().optional(),
  automatedDecision: z.enum(AUTOMATED_DECISIONS).optional(),
  signal: StatementSignal.nullable().optional(),
});
export type DecisionStatement = z.infer<typeof DecisionStatement>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the app: what the author and the reporter read

/** A page cursor of the app's moderation lists: an opaque word the API wrote. */
const ListCursor = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/);

/** How many decisions one page of the author's list holds. */
export const AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One decision in its author's list (3c design, section 7.6): the decisions their author was told of, and no other.
 * `decidedOn` is the decision's UTC day, never the day its case opened, which would tell when a report arrived. `post` is
 * the post a decision about a post concerns, by its id and creation time; null for a decision about the account.
 * `actions` are what the decision did, measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds; `endedInterim` says that
 * what korbat did while deciding ended with it. `ruleId` and `legal` name the rule or the law it rests on (neither for a
 * decision without a ground). `appealUntil` is the end of the appeal's window while an appeal can still be filed, and
 * `reversedOn` the UTC day a final restriction was reversed in full; both null otherwise. `appeal` is where the author's
 * appeal of the decision stands: `pending`, or its answer; null when they filed none.
 */
export const AuthorCaseRow = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(DECISION_KIND_VALUES),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  decidedOn: UtcDay,
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  actions: z.array(z.enum(ACTION_KINDS)),
  endedInterim: z.boolean(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  legal: z.boolean(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  appeal: z.enum(["pending", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave (3e design, section 10.2): until when it counts, and when it was overruled; null for a decision without one. */
  strike: z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() }).nullable(),
  /**
   * 3e Task 5 (design, sections 9.4 and 10.2): the days of the decision's restriction of reporting, which its row names;
   * and the kinds of the measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke (its statement's endedStanding), which the
   * row says ended with it. Absent where the decision holds none.
   */
  reportingDays: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).optional(),
  endedStanding: z.array(z.enum(["suspend", "terminate", "restrict_reporting"])).optional(),
  /**
   * 3e's review (people7; design, section 9.4): the decision's suspension or termination, by its kind, its days (null for a
   * termination) and whether it was announced, which its row names; and what a lift of one lifted, a suspension or a
   * termination, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure. Absent where the decision holds none.
   */
  standingMeasure: z.object({ kind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate"]), days: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).nullable(), announced: z.boolean() }).optional(),
  liftedStanding: z.object({ kind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate"]), replaced: z.boolean() }).optional(),
  /**
   * 3f (design, sections 9.3 and 10.4): on the row of an order decision, whether its measure keeps the post from its author
   * too (`disabled`) or only from everyone else (`removed`, a DSA order that does not withhold); on the correction that
   * reinstates after one, `lifted`. Such a row names no rule. Absent on every other row.
   */
  order: z.enum(["disabled", "removed", "lifted"]).optional(),
  /**
   * 3f's review (people9; design, section 9.3): on the row of an order decision, the UTC day its author was told, which the
   * row shows in place of `decidedOn` and by which the list places it: a notice released after a hold is told weeks after
   * the disabling. Absent on every other row.
   */
  toldOn: UtcDay.optional(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 9.4 and 10.2): the decision has no decider, so its screen shows [auto.chip] "Taken by a
   * program". Absent, as before 3d, it reads false.
   */
  byProgram: z.boolean().optional(),
});
export type AuthorCaseRow = z.infer<typeof AuthorCaseRow>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/cases: the decisions about the viewer's account, newest first, and how many strikes of the account
 * count now (active_strikes), which the block "Your standing" above the list prints.
 */
export const AuthorCasesPage = z.object({ decisions: z.array(AuthorCaseRow).max(AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable(), activeStrikes: Count });
export type AuthorCasesPage = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesPage>;

/** 3d Task 2 (section 10.2): how many notices one page of GET /api/moderation/notices holds. */
export const AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE = 20;
/** How many of a release's posts its notice lists by their time; `postCount` counts them all. */
export const RELEASE_NOTICE_POSTS_MAX = 20;
/**
 * 3d Task 2 (sections 9.6 and 10.2): GET /api/moderation/notices, the notices about the viewer's own posts that are not
 * decisions, newest first: the releases of sealed images of their posts, each with its id and time, and never one
 * whose notice is held. Task 7 adds the refusals of uploads (`upload_refused`).
 */
export const AuthorNoticesPage = z.object({
  notices: z.array(z.object({ kind: z.enum(["release", "upload_refused"]), id: z.uuid(), at: z.iso.datetime() })).max(AUTHOR_NOTICES_PAGE_SIZE),
  nextCursor: z.string().nullable(),
});
export type AuthorNoticesPage = z.infer<typeof AuthorNoticesPage>;

/**
 * 3d review L11 (people9): where the author's appeal of the decision that sealed stands, which the notice's paragraph on
 * that decision follows: none filed (or a held upload's release, which has no such decision), pending, or answered.
 * Never the answer's word: the decision's own screen gives it.
 */
export const RELEASE_NOTICE_APPEALS = ["none", "pending", "answered"] as const;
export type ReleaseNoticeAppeal = (typeof RELEASE_NOTICE_APPEALS)[number];

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (sections 9.6, 10.2 and W.6): GET /api/moderation/releases/:release, what releaseNoticeParagraphs reads, and
 * the decision that sealed, for the link to its screen, with where its appeal stands (review L11). Never an answer's word
 * or an assessment, who gave the leave, an authority or a reference. The route answers not_found to anyone but the posts'
 * author, and while the release's notice is held.
 */
export const ReleaseNoticeView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  basis: z.enum(RELEASE_BASES),
  releasedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  backupsClearAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  /** A held upload's release (Task 7); false for a seal's. */
  upload: z.boolean(),
  posts: z.array(z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() })).max(RELEASE_NOTICE_POSTS_MAX),
  postCount: Count,
  /** The image rows the release erased: the seal's count of each post's images. */
  images: Count,
  sealDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  appeal: z.enum(RELEASE_NOTICE_APPEALS),
});
export type ReleaseNoticeView = z.infer<typeof ReleaseNoticeView>;

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 7.12, 9.5, 10.2 and W.5): GET /api/moderation/uploads/:refusal, what uploadNoticeParagraphs
 * reads of a refused upload, for its uploader alone, and nothing of the file: no hash, no classification string, no list
 * version, no admin. `matchKind` is derived as in a statement (statementMatchKind) and `listedAs` is always csam: only an
 * acting match is ever refused. `mayObject` is 7.12's one rule. `endedAt`, `endAs` and `endReason` are null while the hold
 * stands, and for an end as no_report until its delay has passed: the uploader is told of that end when it is one.
 * `released` is the release's time, null while there is none or its notice is held. `reportKept` is true while a record of
 * a report under 3f names the refusal.
 */
export const UploadRefusalView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  refusedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  source: z.string().min(1).max(100),
  matchKind: z.enum(MATCH_KINDS),
  listedAs: z.literal("csam"),
  objection: z.object({ text: z.string(), objectedAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  mayObject: z.boolean(),
  endedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endAs: z.enum(UPLOAD_ENDS).nullable(),
  endReason: z.enum(UPLOAD_END_REASONS).nullable(),
  released: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reportKept: z.boolean(),
});
export type UploadRefusalView = z.infer<typeof UploadRefusalView>;

/** A strike as its decision's screen shows it: until when it counts, whether it still counts, ran out or was overruled, and when. */
export const DecisionStrike = z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), state: z.enum(["counts", "expired", "overruled"]), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() });
export type DecisionStrike = z.infer<typeof DecisionStrike>;

export const AuthorCasesQuery = z.object({ cursor: ListCursor.optional() });
export type AuthorCasesQuery = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesQuery>;

/**
 * An image of the content a decision was made on, as the app's own image route serves it to its author. It is listed
 * only while that route serves it: never for a sealed image or one of a post its author deleted.
 */
export const DecisionImage = z.object({ id: MediaId, alt: z.string(), width: z.number().int().positive(), height: z.number().int().positive(), small: z.string(), large: z.string() });
export type DecisionImage = z.infer<typeof DecisionImage>;

/**
 * The content a decision was made on, from the decision's snapshot, or the reason it is not shown; the first that
 * applies, in this order (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10):
 *   - `r4_redacted`: an R4 redaction erased it when the restriction became final;
 *   - `erased`: korbat's copy was erased under its retention rules, on `contentErasedOn` (a UTC day); `postKept` says
 *     that the post itself is still in its author's profile;
 *   - `post`: the post's text, which is never sealed, and its images. `imagesHidden` says why none is listed: `sealed`
 *     (nobody is shown them, the author included), or `deleted_by_author` (kept for the case, served to nobody);
 *     `imageCount` is how many the snapshot holds either way. `deletedByAuthor` says that the author deleted the post;
 *   - `account`: the account's fields as the snapshot held them, which for a field reset is the value the reset removed.
 */
export const DecisionContent = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("r4_redacted") }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("erased"), contentErasedOn: UtcDay, postKept: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    kind: z.literal("post"),
    body: z.string(),
    deletedByAuthor: z.boolean(),
    images: z.array(DecisionImage),
    imageCount: Count,
    imagesHidden: z.enum(["sealed", "deleted_by_author"]).nullable(),
  }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("account"), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string(), bio: z.string() }),
]);
export type DecisionContent = z.infer<typeof DecisionContent>;

/**
 * The author's appeal as the decision's screen shows it (3c design, sections 7.7 and 10).
 *   - `pending`: `reviewer` says whether anyone at korbat may review it now and, when nobody may, whether that is
 *     because korbat has one moderator (or one admin); `needsAdmin` that its review is an admin's, which is true only
 *     when the decision cites R2 or sealed images, both of which its author was told. Neither says who took part in
 *     the case or why someone may not review it.
 *   - `answered`: the result, the UTC day, and the answering decision with its statement's data, which the screen
 *     renders as it renders every statement: the review, or the correction that reversed everything before a review.
 */
export const DecisionAppeal = z.discriminatedUnion("state", [
  z.strictObject({ state: z.literal("pending"), filedAt: z.iso.datetime(), reviewer: ReviewerState, needsAdmin: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    state: z.literal("answered"),
    filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    answeredOn: UtcDay,
    result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
    answeredBy: z.uuid(),
    statement: DecisionStatement,
  }),
]);
export type DecisionAppeal = z.infer<typeof DecisionAppeal>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/decisions/:id: one decision as its author reads it (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10). It is the
 * statement's data, which the app renders with statementParagraphs exactly as the mail was rendered, and what the
 * author's screen adds: `appealUntil` and `reversedOn` as the list gives them, the content actioned, and `appeal`, the
 * author's appeal of this decision (null when they filed none).
 */
/**
 * 3e (design, sections 9.2 and 10.2): where a decision's suspension or termination stands now, read fresh, beside the
 * statement that never changes. `state` as the case page's period has it (unfixed, announced, held, running, ended, never,
 * lifted, basis_ended); the earliest start the statement names; the start and the end once the database has them (the end
 * null for a termination); when it stopped early, and by which decision (`endedBy`: the one that lifted it, withdrew it
 * signed `replaced`, or broke its basis), with `replaced` true for a withdrawal; each decision it rests on (a strike's with
 * where that strike stands now); the reply, with its text while korbat keeps it; and whether a reply can still be sent.
 */
export const DecisionStanding = z.object({
  state: z.enum(PERIOD_STATES),
  earliestStart: z.iso.datetime(),
  startsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endedBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
  replaced: z.boolean(),
  restsOn: z.array(
    z.object({
      decisionId: z.uuid(),
      ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
      decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
      countsUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
      state: z.enum(["counts", "expired", "overruled"]).nullable(),
      overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
    }),
  ),
  reply: z
    .object({ filedAt: z.iso.datetime(), onTime: z.boolean(), text: z.string().nullable(), erasedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(), answeredAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(), answeredBy: z.uuid().nullable() })
    .nullable(),
  replyOpen: z.boolean(),
});
export type DecisionStanding = z.infer<typeof DecisionStanding>;

/**
 * 3e Task 5 (design, sections 9.2 and 10.2): where a decision's restriction of reporting stands now, read fresh: `running`
 * until its end; `ended` once its days ran out; `lifted` by a review or a correction of its own decision; `basis_ended`
 * when it ended with the warning it rested on, which korbat lifted. `until` is its end as decided (its start plus its
 * days); `endedAt` and `endedBy` the time and the decision that lifted it, or that lifted its warning (null otherwise).
 */
export const ReportingStanding = z.object({
  state: z.enum(["running", "ended", "lifted", "basis_ended"]),
  until: z.iso.datetime(),
  endedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  endedBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
});
export type ReportingStanding = z.infer<typeof ReportingStanding>;

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and 10.2): where "Ask for a person" stands on a program's decision. `open` while a
 * measure of it is in force and no objection exists; `asked` with the text and its time while the measure stays in force;
 * `decided` once no measure of it is in force, naming the person's decision that ended it and its time. No lapse by time
 * moves it: only a person's decision does.
 */
export const AskPerson = z.discriminatedUnion("state", [
  z.object({ state: z.literal("open") }),
  z.object({ state: z.literal("asked"), text: z.string(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }),
  z.object({ state: z.literal("decided"), decisionId: z.uuid(), decidedAt: z.iso.datetime() }),
]);
export type AskPerson = z.infer<typeof AskPerson>;

export const DecisionView = DecisionStatement.extend({
  id: z.uuid(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  /** 3f: null for an order decision while its measure is in force and after its preservation erased the post (10.4). */
  content: DecisionContent.nullable(),
  appeal: DecisionAppeal.nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave, read fresh (3e design, section 10.2); null for a decision without one. */
  strike: DecisionStrike.nullable(),
  /** 3e Task 4: where the decision's suspension or termination stands now; null for a decision without one. */
  standing: DecisionStanding.nullable(),
  /** 3e Task 5: where the decision's restriction of reporting stands now; null (or absent) for a decision without one. */
  reportingStanding: ReportingStanding.nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3f (design, section 10.4), read fresh for an order decision and the correction of one: the authority's words as the
   * command line recorded them, and `textsAt`, the time the newest of them was told to the author; and `erasedOn`, the
   * day the preservation's end erased the content. Null (or absent) for every other decision.
   */
  orderTexts: OrderTexts.nullable().optional(),
  erasedOn: UtcDay.nullable().optional(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10, 9.4 and 10.2): "Ask for a person" on a program's decision, read fresh; null for a
   * decision with a decider (and absent before 3d).
   */
  askPerson: AskPerson.nullable().optional(),
});
export type DecisionView = z.infer<typeof DecisionView>;

/** How many reports one page of the reporter's list holds. */
export const REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One item of a report in its sender's own list: the item as the status page gives it, and its id, by which the signed-in
 * sender asks for its re-examination. The status page, which anyone holding a link may open, names an item by its
 * position and never carries an id.
 */
export const ReportItem = NoticeItemStatus.extend({
  id: z.uuid(),
  /**
   * 3e Task 5 (design, sections 7.9 step 3, 9.4 and 10.2): a moderator marked this item "manifestly unfounded" and the mark
   * still counts (no correction withdrew it, no re-examination of it ended in a restriction, its report is within the

export type RestoreGap = z.infer<typeof RestoreGap>;

 *     newest strike's rule and day, the most days an announced suspension could take now, and whether a termination
 *     could be announced.

});
export type StandingLists = z.infer<typeof StandingLists>;

import { z } from "zod";

import { FORBIDDEN_FORMAT } from "./text";

// imports nothing from the other modules of the contracts but text.ts, which imports nothing, and (3d Task 3) media.ts,
// which imports only text.ts, for the edge's numbers and the purge line of an order's item: moderation.ts reads its
// constants for the staff overview, staff.ts its step-up params, and the watcher (apps/api/src/notify), which imports the
// contracts and nothing of the API, renders its pushes from it.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the numbers

/**
 * The numbers of 3f, the same as the SQL function order_rules() returns, which a database test compares member by
 * member: one constant mirrors one function, as STANDING_RULES mirrors standing_rules(). Every function and view of 3f
 * reads its numbers from there, and every word of the console, the pushes and the mails from here. Each is a cautious
 * default flagged for the owner (3f design, section 2): one line to change in each place.
 */
export const ORDER_RULES = {
  /** A removal order's hour (TCO Art. 3(3)); a restart of its clock is a fresh one; a message's deadline as an order. */
  hourMinutes: 60,
  /** The console's target. It stays with 3d's purge at the edge, which is unconfirmed and can fail (3d design, row 13). */
  targetMinutes: 55,
  /** The most items one "Disable for an order" confirms, and the most links one request names. */
  itemsPerAction: 10,
  /** Order decisions of one staff account in 24 hours. */
  decisionsPerDay: 50,
  /** Order records one staff account opens in 24 hours. */
  recordsPerDay: 20,
  /** A removal order's computed hold, and its one extension. */
  holdDays: 43,
  holdExtensionDays: 42,
  /** Every staff account is alerted this long before a held notice is released. */
  holdWarningDays: 7,
  /** No shorter hold for a tick the command line has not confirmed; a number here would cap it. */
  unconfirmedHoldHours: null,
  /** How long what a removal order disabled is preserved: months from the disabling, and a margin of days. */
  preserveMonths: 6,
  preserveMarginDays: 1,
  /** How long a deletion keeps the address while a report is owed, and when an owed report is alerted. */
  reportHoldDays: 7,
  reportAlertHours: 24,
  /** A message read more than this long after it arrived is stale and raises no push. */
  staleHours: 2,
  /** While an unhandled message's first push is this young, a further message raises no first push of its own; 0 switches the bound off. */
  quietMinutes: 15,
  /** When an unanswered message rings every phone, and the first reminder of its deadline. */
  escalateMinutes: 15,
  remindMinutes: 45,
  /** When the channel reads as down, and how long a row is still owed its push. */
  channelDownMinutes: 3,
  pushOwedMinutes: 60,
  /** When the copy of the audit log's tail is overdue, and when a hand-over archive not destroyed is alerted. */
  copyOverdueHours: 48,
  handoverAlertDays: 7,
  /** How long a handled message, an order's records and a closed restore gap are kept. */
  messageKeepDays: 30,
  recordKeepYears: 3,
  gapKeepMonths: 12,
} as const;
export type OrderRules = typeof ORDER_RULES;

/** What the database never reads: the watcher's round, the alert tick's, and how long the tick tries a row's mail. */

} as const;

/**
 * 3d (design, sections 6.1, 7.1 and 8.2; W.7): a move of sealed files into the quarantine, or back to the image store, is

 * threshold, make_interval(days => 1), which a database test holds to this number. The words that state it print it from

export const QUARANTINE_RULES = {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the contact point

export type ContactPage = z.infer<typeof ContactPage>;

/** The list's query: after the cursor the API handed out, and only the messages without a disposition with open=1. */
export const ContactQuery = z.strictObject({
  cursor: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  open: z.literal("1").optional(),
});
export type ContactQuery = z.infer<typeof ContactQuery>;

/** POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close. */
export const ContactCloseRequest = z.strictObject({ disposition: z.enum(CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS) });
export type ContactCloseRequest = z.infer<typeof ContactCloseRequest>;

/** The channel's state on the console's home: up, down, the mailbox unreadable, or switched off on this server. */
export const ALERT_CHANNEL_STATES = ["ok", "down", "mailbox", "off"] as const;
export type AlertChannelState = (typeof ALERT_CHANNEL_STATES)[number];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the alerts

/**
 * The closed list of alerts, the CHECK of alert_outbox.kind written from it: 3f's kinds, then 3c's and 3e's six, whose
 * mails stay their own and which gain a push, then 3d's.
 */
export const ALERT_KIND_LIST = [
  "contact_mail",
  "contact_mail_escalated",
  "order_due",
  "order_opened",
  "order_corrected",
  "order_effected",
  "order_reinstated",
  "order_unverified",
  "hold_ending",
  "report_owed",
  "handover_undestroyed",
  "copy_overdue",
  "copy_taken",
  "alert_channel_down",
  "mailbox_unreachable",
  "alert_test",
  "moderation_urgent",
  "moderation_waiting",
  "moderation_burst",
  "moderation_reads",
  "moderation_reveal",
  "moderation_csam_lifted",
  // 3d (design, section 10.1): its kinds, each a sentence to every staff account. Task 1: a move of sealed files that is
  // due (alert_steps(), daily) and files the quarantine's record says are lost (staff.js quarantine-record).
  "quarantine_due",
  "quarantine_lost",
  // Task 2: a released file still recorded in the quarantine (alert_steps(), daily), and an admin's release of sealed
  // images (after the release's commit, to every staff account, the admin who released included).
  "release_undestroyed",
  "seal_released",
  // Task 3: the outbox's job gave up on purges at the edge (its own row, under F's daily rule).
  "edge_purge_failed",
  // Task 5: the transparency job published a day's value without an outside timestamp, or found the day before without
  // a published value (each its own row, under F's daily rule).
  "head_unwitnessed",
  "head_missed",
  // Task 6: an author asked for a person about a program's measure (staffAlert after the objection's commit, at most once
  // in 15 minutes); a cap or a limit refused a program's measure (staffAlert after the step's commit, at most once an
  // hour); a request for a person waited longer than the published target (the sweep's own row, under F's daily rule).
  "automated_objection",
  "automation_capped",
  "automated_waiting",
  // Task 7: the comparison of uploads needs the operator (alert_steps(), daily, while a check stays unanswered; and at once
  // by the first upload of an hour that matched over the limit on refusals); and an admin ended a held upload's hold
  // without a report (staffAlert after the end's commit, to every staff account, the admin included, no throttle).
  "matcher_down",
  "hold_ended_unreported",
  // 3d review M13: a day's value whose keeper's mail never went out (the transparency job's own row in the next day's first
  // round, under F's daily rule, while HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL is set).
  "head_unmailed",
] as const;
export type AlertKind = (typeof ALERT_KIND_LIST)[number];

export type AlertLeg = "push" | "mail";
/** The ntfy topic of a push: the phone on call, or every staff phone. A mail goes to every staff account whatever the scope. */
export type AlertScope = "on_call" | "all";

/** One kind's entry: its priority and scope, its legs, who renders its mail, and the names of its facts. */
export interface AlertKindEntry {
  readonly priority: 3 | 5;
  readonly scope: AlertScope;
  readonly legs: readonly AlertLeg[];
  /**
   * `sentence`: the mail is the kind's own entry of ALERT_TEXTS, which the alert tick can mail again from the row's facts;
   * `own`: a mail of 3c or 3e that says more than the facts hold, which only staffAlert sends; null: pushed only.
   */
  readonly mail: "sentence" | "own" | null;
  /** The names of the row's facts: counts and times, at most six. */
  readonly facts: readonly string[];
}

const both: readonly AlertLeg[] = ["push", "mail"];
const sentenceKind = (priority: 3 | 5, scope: AlertScope, facts: readonly string[]): AlertKindEntry => ({ priority, scope, legs: both, mail: "sentence", facts });
const ownKind = (priority: 3 | 5, scope: AlertScope, facts: readonly string[]): AlertKindEntry => ({ priority, scope, legs: both, mail: "own", facts });

/**
 * Each kind's facts under the names the sentences print. `order_opened` carries `unknown` (1 for an order opened without
 * a time of receipt, else 0) beside its count and its deadline, so its sentence can tell "No deadline runs" from "Its
 * deadline is unknown"; `order_effected` carries `urgent` the same way.
 */
export const ALERT_KINDS: Record<AlertKind, AlertKindEntry> = {
  contact_mail: sentenceKind(5, "on_call", ["receivedAt", "dueAt"]),
  contact_mail_escalated: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["receivedAt", "dueAt"]),
  order_due: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["dueAt", "minutesLeft", "itemsOpen"]),
  order_opened: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["items", "dueAt", "unknown"]),
  order_corrected: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "at"]),
  order_effected: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["items", "at", "itemsOpen", "urgent"]),
  order_reinstated: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
  order_unverified: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["count", "textsMissing", "holdsOpen", "oldestAt"]),
  hold_ending: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "at"]),
  report_owed: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  handover_undestroyed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  copy_overdue: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["hours"]),
  copy_taken: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "rows"]),
  alert_channel_down: { priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["since"] },
  mailbox_unreachable: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["since"]),
  alert_test: { priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push"], mail: null, facts: ["at"] },
  // 3d review L8: `count` is the lane's cases alone, `oldestAt` the oldest case's (absent when none waits), and
  // `heldUploads` the held uploads that wait, a fact of their own.
  moderation_urgent: ownKind(5, "on_call", ["count", "oldestAt", "heldUploads"]),
  moderation_waiting: ownKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  moderation_burst: ownKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  moderation_reads: ownKind(3, "all", ["limit"]),
  moderation_reveal: ownKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
  moderation_csam_lifted: ownKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
  quarantine_due: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  quarantine_lost: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "at"]),
  release_undestroyed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  seal_released: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "posts", "uploads"]),
  edge_purge_failed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  head_unwitnessed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["day"]),
  head_missed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["day"]),
  automated_objection: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "count"]),
  // The limit met is one of four facts, each 1 when present (CAP_LIMITS): a row's facts are counts and instants only, so
  // the limit's word cannot be a fact of its own.
  automation_capped: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "count", "limitHour", "limitDay", "limitUnanswered", "limitWaiting"]),
  automated_waiting: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  matcher_down: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["since", "count", "refusalsCapped"]),
  // The time after which the upload is deleted is a time fact, so it ends in At (W.7's `until`).
  hold_ended_unreported: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "deletesAt"]),
  head_unmailed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["day"]),
};

/** The kinds the watcher publishes: every kind with a push leg. */
export const PUSH_KINDS: readonly AlertKind[] = ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].legs.includes("push"));
/** The kinds whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick mails from the row. */
export const SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS: readonly AlertKind[] = ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail === "sentence");

/** The facts of a row: counts, and instants as ISO strings in UTC. */
export type AlertFacts = Readonly<Record<string, number | string>>;

/**
 * A fact that is a day (3d Task 5's head alerts): the row holds the day's first instant, as it holds every time, and
 * renderAlert prints it as the day itself ("2026-10-16", rule 7 of the 3d design's section 18), never as a time of day.
 */
export const isDayFact = (name: string): boolean => name === "day";

/** A fact that is a time: `at`, `since`, a name that ends in At, or a day. Every other fact is a count. */
export const isTimeFact = (name: string): boolean => name === "at" || name === "since" || name.endsWith("At") || isDayFact(name);

/** What a part of a sentence is printed under: a fact present or missing, above zero, or equal to 1 or not. */
export interface AlertCondition {
  readonly fact: string;
  readonly is: "present" | "absent" | "positive" | "one" | "not_one";
}
/** A part of a sentence, printed when its condition holds; the parts printed are joined with a space. */
export interface AlertPart {
  readonly text: string;
  /** One condition, or several that must all hold. */
  readonly when?: AlertCondition | readonly AlertCondition[];
}
/** A kind's words: the title, the sentence in parts, and for a kind whose mail is its sentence the mail's line of what to do. */
export interface AlertText {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly sentence: readonly AlertPart[];
  readonly todo: string | null;
}

const NOT_LISTED = 'An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed".';
const KEY_TOLD = "Every staff account gets this. If it was confirmed with your key and not by you, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.";
const one = (text: string): readonly AlertPart[] => [{ text }];

/**
 * A placeholder in braces: a fact's name, or a member of ORDER_RULES, of QUARANTINE_RULES, (3d Task 3) of EDGE_WORDS or (3d
 * Task 6) of AUTOMATION_RULES.
 */
const PLACEHOLDER = /[{]([a-zA-Z]+)[}]/g;

/** Every placeholder a kind's words name, each once. */
export function alertPlaceholders(kind: AlertKind): string[] {
  const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
  const words = [text.title, ...text.sentence.map((part) => part.text), text.todo ?? ""].join(" ");
  return [...new Set([...words.matchAll(PLACEHOLDER)].map((found) => found[1]!))];
}

/** The form of a time in a row's facts: an instant in UTC with up to six decimals of a second. */
export const ALERT_TIME = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{1,6})?Z$/;

const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

/** An alert's time (rule 5 of section 18): "14:05 UTC", with the day before it when it is not the day of `now` in UTC. */
export function alertTime(iso: string, now: Date): string {
  const at = new Date(iso);
  const clock = `${two(at.getUTCHours())}:${two(at.getUTCMinutes())} UTC`;
  const day = `${at.getUTCFullYear()}-${two(at.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${two(at.getUTCDate())}`;
  const today = `${now.getUTCFullYear()}-${two(now.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${two(now.getUTCDate())}`;
  return day === today ? clock : `${day} ${clock}`;
}

/** Whether a part's condition, or every one of its conditions, holds for the facts. */
function holds(when: AlertPart["when"], facts: AlertFacts): boolean {
  if (when === undefined) return true;
  if (Array.isArray(when)) return when.every((condition: AlertCondition) => holds(condition, facts));
  const condition = when as AlertCondition;
  const value = facts[condition.fact];
  switch (condition.is) {
    case "present":
      return value !== undefined;
    case "absent":
      return value === undefined;
    case "positive":
      return typeof value === "number" && value > 0;
    case "one":
      return value === 1;
    case "not_one":
      return value !== 1;
  }
}

/** The facts held to the kind's names and kinds: a time where the name is a time's, a whole number elsewhere. */
function checkFacts(kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts): void {
  const names = ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts;
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    if (!names.includes(name)) throw new Error(`alert ${kind}: the fact ${name} is not one of its facts`);
    if (isTimeFact(name) ? typeof value !== "string" || !ALERT_TIME.test(value) : typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
      throw new Error(`alert ${kind}: the fact ${name} is not ${isTimeFact(name) ? "a time" : "a count"}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * A kind's title, sentence and line of what to do, filled from the facts, ORDER_RULES, QUARANTINE_RULES and EDGE_WORDS. A time
 * prints as alertTime does at `now`, and a day as the date of its instant in UTC. A placeholder with nothing to fill it, a
 * fact of another kind and a fact of the wrong form throw: an alert never goes out with a hole or with anything but
 * counts and times in it.
 */
export function renderAlert(kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts, now: Date): { title: string; sentence: string; todo: string | null } {
  checkFacts(kind, facts);
  const rules = { ...ORDER_RULES, ...QUARANTINE_RULES, ...EDGE_WORDS, ...AUTOMATION_RULES } as Record<string, number | null>;
  const fill = (text: string) =>
    text.replace(PLACEHOLDER, (_match, name: string) => {
      const value = facts[name];
      if (value !== undefined) return typeof value === "string" ? (isDayFact(name) ? value.slice(0, 10) : alertTime(value, now)) : String(value);
      const rule = Object.hasOwn(rules, name) ? rules[name] : undefined;
      if (typeof rule === "number") return String(rule);
      throw new Error(`alert ${kind}: nothing fills {${name}}`);
    });
  const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
  return {
    title: fill(text.title),
    sentence: text.sentence
      .filter((part) => holds(part.when, facts))
      .map((part) => fill(part.text))
      .join(" "),
    todo: text.todo === null ? null : fill(text.todo),
  };
}

/**
 * The digest that a later step of a notification record (its answer, an event) and every step of a production hold in
 * their audit row in place of the facts (10.5): the SHA-256, in hex, of the record's row at that step in the canonical
 * JSON (canonical.ts), as the database printed it. The chain proves the record existed and was not changed afterwards,
 * and `staff.js records --verify` recomputes it from the row, without the audit log ever naming the person.
 */
export async function recordDigestOf(row: unknown): Promise<string> {
  return hex(await sha256(sortedJson(row)));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the requests (10.2, 10.3)

/** A uuid in the lower case PostgreSQL writes: the one spelling a hashed param may take. */
const LowerUuid = z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/, { message: "a uuid in lower case" });

/** Whether a text holds a control character: C0, DEL or C1. */
const hasControl = (text: string) =>
  [...text].some((char) => {
    const code = char.codePointAt(0)!;
    return code < 32 || (code >= 127 && code < 160);
  });
/** Whether a string is whole text, with no half of a surrogate pair. */
const isWellFormed = (text: string) => (text as string & { isWellFormed(): boolean }).isWellFormed();

/**
 * One line typed from an order's document: an authority's name, a reference, a link. Stored as written or refused: well
 * formed, no control character, none of the invisible direction and spacing characters, some text, at most `max`
 * characters as PostgreSQL counts them. It is an outsider's text, and the console draws it as such.
 */
const orderLine = (max: number) =>
  z
    .string()
    // A character outside the basic plane is two UTF-16 units, so this bound never refuses what the count below accepts.
    .max(2 * max)
    .refine(isWellFormed, { message: "half of a surrogate pair is not text" })
    .refine((text) => !hasControl(text), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
    .refine((text) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(text), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
    .refine((text) => text.trim().length > 0, { message: "some text is needed" })
    .refine((text) => Array.from(text).length <= max, { message: `at most ${max} characters` });
export const OrderAuthority = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.name);
export const OrderReference = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.name);
export const OrderLinkText = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.link);

const distinct = (values: readonly string[]) => new Set(values).size === values.length;
const orderLinks = (min: number) => z.array(OrderLinkText).min(min).max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction).refine(distinct, { message: "a link is named once" });

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders (7.4). sectionC is required and has no default: the form's third choice, "I cannot tell", is
 * sent as true. A named message comes with the channel mailbox, which the database forces too. The withholding is true
 * for a removal order and whenever Section C is set, so no request can hold a notice on a post its author sees; an order
 * to provide information names no post, so it does not withhold unless Section C forces it. It takes no link; the other
 * two kinds take one to itemsPerAction.
 */
export const OrderOpenRequest = z
  .strictObject({
    messageId: z.uuid().nullable(),
    channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS),
    kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS),
    memberState: MemberStateCode,
    authority: OrderAuthority,
    reference: OrderReference,
    links: orderLinks(0),
    sectionC: z.boolean(),
    emergency: z.boolean(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
  })
  .superRefine((request, ctx) => {
    if (request.messageId !== null && request.channel !== "mailbox") ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["channel"], message: "an order opened from a message arrived in the mailbox" });
    if ((request.kind === "tco_removal" || request.sectionC) && !request.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "a removal order, and an order whose author must not be told, keeps the post from its author" });
    }
    if (request.kind === "dsa_art10" && !request.sectionC && request.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "an order to provide information names no post to withhold" });
    }
    if (request.kind === "dsa_art10" ? request.links.length > 0 : request.links.length === 0) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["links"], message: "an order to provide information takes no link; the other kinds take at least one" });
    }
  });
export type OrderOpenRequest = z.infer<typeof OrderOpenRequest>;

/** POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items: one to itemsPerAction more links, up to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX in all. */
export const OrderItemsRequest = z.strictObject({ links: orderLinks(1) });
export type OrderItemsRequest = z.infer<typeof OrderItemsRequest>;

/**
 * What a correction changes (7.4): only the members to change, at least one. crossBorder is the API's, set with
 * memberState. closeItems closes open items, each with one reason, no item twice. Section C set never comes with the
 * withholding unset.
 */
export const OrderCorrectFacts = z
  .strictObject({
    kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS).optional(),
    memberState: MemberStateCode.optional(),
    authority: OrderAuthority.optional(),
    reference: OrderReference.optional(),
    channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS).optional(),
    sectionC: z.boolean().optional(),
    emergency: z.boolean().optional(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean().optional(),
    closeItems: z
      .array(z.strictObject({ itemId: LowerUuid, reason: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS) }))
      .min(1)
      .max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction)
      .refine((items) => distinct(items.map((item) => item.itemId)), { message: "an item is closed once" })
      .optional(),
  })
  .refine((facts) => Object.keys(facts).length > 0, { message: "a correction changes something" })
  .refine((facts) => !(facts.sectionC === true && facts.withholdFromAuthor === false), { message: "an order whose author must not be told keeps the post from its author", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"] });
export type OrderCorrectFacts = z.infer<typeof OrderCorrectFacts>;

/** The step-up params of order_corrected, asked only under the rule admin: the request's facts (10.3). */
export const OrderCorrectedParams = z.strictObject({ facts: OrderCorrectFacts });
export type OrderCorrectedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderCorrectedParams>;

/** Every ground a console event takes: an Annex III's and a closing's, each once. A param is never a free string. */
const CONSOLE_EVENT_GROUNDS = [...ANNEX3_GROUNDS, ...ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS] as const;

/**
 * The step-up params of order_event_recorded (10.3): the kind, its ground (one of its kind's list, or null for a kind
 * without one) and the message it names, which a clarification and an extension need, a cease may have and nothing else
 * takes.
 */
export const OrderEventRecordedParams = z
  .strictObject({ kind: z.enum(ORDER_CONSOLE_EVENTS), ground: z.enum(CONSOLE_EVENT_GROUNDS).nullable(), messageId: LowerUuid.nullable() })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    const grounds = orderEventGrounds(params.kind);
    if (grounds === null ? params.ground !== null : params.ground === null || !grounds.includes(params.ground)) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["ground"], message: grounds === null ? "this event has no ground" : "a ground of this event's list" });
    }
    const needs = params.kind === "clarification_received" || params.kind === "hold_extended";
    const may = needs || params.kind === "grounds_ceased";
    if ((needs && params.messageId === null) || (!may && params.messageId !== null)) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["messageId"], message: needs ? "this event names the message it came in" : "this event names no message" });
    }
  });
export type OrderEventRecordedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderEventRecordedParams>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the answers (10.2)

const At = z.iso.datetime();

/** A removal order's clock: one row of legal_order_clock, with the newest Annex III's time and ground while it is stopped. */
export const OrderClock = z.strictObject({
  clockStart: At.nullable(),
  stopped: z.boolean(),
  stoppedAt: At.nullable(),
  stopGround: z.enum(ANNEX3_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  deadlineAt: At.nullable(),
  targetAt: At.nullable(),
  itemsOpen: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  firstEffectAt: At.nullable(),
  lastEffectAt: At.nullable(),
  withinHour: z.boolean().nullable(),
});
export type OrderClock = z.infer<typeof OrderClock>;

/** One order on the list: its facts as typed, its clock (null for a DSA order), its state and its counts. */
export const OrderSummary = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS),
  memberState: MemberStateCode,
  authority: z.string(),
  reference: z.string(),
  openedAt: At,
  state: z.enum(ORDER_STATES),
  clock: OrderClock.nullable(),
  /** A DSA order's deadline as its text states it, or null. */
  dueAt: At.nullable(),
  closedAt: At.nullable(),
  closeGround: z.enum(ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  items: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  itemsInForce: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  noticesHeld: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type OrderSummary = z.infer<typeof OrderSummary>;

/** GET /api/staff/orders: the orders that are not closed, the nearest deadline first, and those closed in the last 30 days. */
export const OrdersPage = z.strictObject({ open: z.array(OrderSummary), closed: z.array(OrderSummary) });
export type OrdersPage = z.infer<typeof OrdersPage>;

/** The stored states of a post, as an order's item reads them live. */
export const ORDER_ITEM_POST_STATES = ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "deleted_by_author", "disabled"] as const;

/** One item of an order: its link as named, what it resolved to (read live), and what became of it. */
export const OrderItemView = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  position: z.number().int().min(1).max(ORDER_ITEMS_MAX),
  link: z.string(),
  linkKind: z.enum(ORDER_LINK_KINDS),
  addedAt: At,
  /** The order is not verified, or the item was added after its verification. */
  unverified: z.boolean(),
  postId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  /** Null when the link named no post; the preview only while the post is public, and never an image. */
  post: z
    .strictObject({
      authorHandle: z.string().nullable(),
      state: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_POST_STATES),
      images: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
      preview: z.string().nullable(),
      createdAt: At,
      deletedOn: z.iso.date().nullable(),
    })
    .nullable(),
  decisionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  caseId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  inForce: z.boolean(),
  disabledAt: At.nullable(),
  noEffect: z.enum(["deleted", "already"]).nullable(),
  preserveUntil: At.nullable(),
  preserveEndedAt: At.nullable(),
  /**
   * Task 4 (sections 6.4 and 8.5, [item.erased]): when the preservation's end erased the post's content, the same instant
   * as preserveEndedAt; null while nothing was erased, and when the preservation ended without an erasure (a
   * reinstatement, a correction to another kind, or a measure no longer in force).
   */
  erasedAt: At.nullable(),
  reinstatedAt: At.nullable(),
  reinstatedGround: z.enum(ORDER_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  closedAt: At.nullable(),
  closedReason: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS).nullable(),
  /** True when an open restore gap names the item (Task 6 builds the gaps); false until then. */
  gap: z.boolean(),
  /**
   * 3d Task 3 (design, sections 7.4 and 8.4): for an item that was disabled, the newest outbox row of each image of its
   * post that stopped being public, as a case carries them (CaseView.purges); empty for an item never disabled.
   */
  purges: z.array(EdgePurgeView),
});
export type OrderItemView = z.infer<typeof OrderItemView>;

/** One event of an order: who wrote it as a staff handle, or null for the command line and the database. */
export const OrderEventView = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(ORDER_EVENT_KINDS),
  ground: z.string().nullable(),
  at: At,
  effectiveAt: At.nullable(),
  itemId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  by: z.string().nullable(),
  via: z.enum(ORDER_EVENT_VIA),
});
export type OrderEventView = z.infer<typeof OrderEventView>;

/** What the command line still owes an order (7.5), and until when korbat may ask for a scrutiny. */
export const OrderOwed = z.strictObject({
  received: z.boolean(),
  verification: z.boolean(),
  issuedAt: z.boolean(),
  texts: z.boolean(),
  document: z.boolean(),
  holdUntil: z.boolean(),
  tellPerson: z.boolean(),
  scrutinyUntil: At.nullable(),
});
export type OrderOwed = z.infer<typeof OrderOwed>;

/** An order's hold, for an order with Section C: its end (null while a DSA order's has none recorded) and what became of it. */
export const OrderHold = z.strictObject({
  until: At.nullable(),
  basis: z.enum(HOLD_BASES),
  open: z.boolean(),
  extended: z.boolean(),
  endedAt: At.nullable(),
  endReason: z.enum(HOLD_END_REASONS).nullable(),
  releasedAt: At.nullable(),
  noticesHeld: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type OrderHold = z.infer<typeof OrderHold>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/orders/:order: the summary with its items as a list, the row's facts, the events oldest first, what the
 * command line owes, the hold, and the console's aids (the database decides). No text of reasons, redress, scope,
 * verified_how or hold_basis: those are the command line's, and the author's notice is where the first three are read.
 */
export const OrderView = OrderSummary.extend({
  channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS),
  messageId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  receivedAt: At.nullable(),
  sentAt: At.nullable(),
  issuedAt: At.nullable(),
  sectionC: z.boolean(),
  emergency: z.boolean(),
  crossBorder: z.boolean(),
  withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
  preserve: z.boolean(),
  openedBy: z.string().nullable(),
  openedVia: z.enum(["console", "cli"]),
  importedAt: At.nullable(),
  tellPerson: z.strictObject({ rule: z.enum(TELL_PERSON_RULES), at: At.nullable() }).nullable(),
  items: z.array(OrderItemView).max(ORDER_ITEMS_MAX),
  events: z.array(OrderEventView),
  owed: OrderOwed,
  hold: OrderHold.nullable(),
  mayClose: z.boolean(),
  mayEvents: z.array(z.enum(ORDER_CONSOLE_EVENTS)),
  mayCorrect: z.enum(ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES).nullable(),
});
export type OrderView = z.infer<typeof OrderView>;

/** The one refusal of 3f that carries a member: order_exists names the order that stands, so the console links to it. */
export const OrderExistsDetails = z.strictObject({ orderId: z.uuid() });
export type OrderExistsDetails = z.infer<typeof OrderExistsDetails>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- giving effect (Task 3: 7.6, 7.9, 10.1, 10.3, 10.4)

/**
 * What an order decision is by its order's kind (10.1), which decisions_record forces and OrderEffectedParams therefore
 * does not carry. The category of a DSA Article 9 order is a filler for a column that may not be null: korbat did not
 * assess the content, and nothing reads the column for such a decision. A dsa_art10 order is never given effect.
 */
export const ORDER_DECISION = {
  tco_removal: { category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", preserves: true, effectBeforeVerified: true, holdBasis: "regulation" },
  dsa_art9: { category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE", keyword: null, preserves: false, effectBeforeVerified: false, holdBasis: "authority" },
} as const;

/** One item of an effect: an order's item and the post it names, both in lower case. */
const EffectItem = z.strictObject({ itemId: LowerUuid, postId: LowerUuid });

/**
 * The step-up params of order_effected (10.3): the order's facts as the console showed them, `urgent` and the items, 1 to
 * itemsPerAction, sorted by postId with no repeat of either id, so one action has one hash and its order is the lock
 * order. `authority` and `reference` are the one named exception to the rule that a param is never a free string: an
 * authority's name and its file number, bound as an order's lines are, which decision_holds compares with the order's
 * row at commit. `withholdFromAuthor` is true for a removal order and whenever Section C is set, and `urgent` is refused
 * for a removal order (the database refuses it on a verified order too).
 */
export const OrderEffectedParams = z
  .strictObject({
    kind: z.enum(["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"]),
    memberState: MemberStateCode,
    authority: OrderAuthority,
    reference: OrderReference,
    sectionC: z.boolean(),
    emergency: z.boolean(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
    urgent: z.boolean(),
    items: z.array(EffectItem).min(1).max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction),
  })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    if ((params.kind === "tco_removal" || params.sectionC) && !params.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "a removal order, and an order whose author must not be told, keeps the post from its author" });
    }
    if (params.kind === "tco_removal" && params.urgent) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["urgent"], message: "a removal order is given effect without a check first: urgent means nothing for it" });
    const posts = params.items.map((item) => item.postId);
    if (posts.some((post, i) => i > 0 && posts[i - 1]! >= post)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["items"], message: "the items are sorted by post, without repeats" });
    if (!distinct(params.items.map((item) => item.itemId))) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["items"], message: "an item is named once" });
  });
export type OrderEffectedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderEffectedParams>;

/**
 * The fixed reasons of a reinstatement (W.2's reinstated.<ground>), which the composer saves as the correction's reason
 * and which nobody edits: a free text beside an order could say what a non-disclosure decision forbids.
 */
export const ORDER_DRAFTS = {
  reinstate: {
    withdrawn: "The authority that issued the order withdrew it.",
    annulled: "A court annulled the order.",
    scrutiny:
      "The competent authority of korbat's own Member State scrutinised the order and decided that it infringes the Regulation or fundamental rights, so the order no longer has effect (Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2021/784).",
    not_authentic: "The order was not authentic: it did not come from the authority it named. korbat disabled your post on a forged order, and regrets it.",
    wrong_item: "korbat made a mistake: the order did not name this post. korbat disabled it wrongly, and regrets it.",
  },
} as const satisfies { reinstate: Record<OrderGround, string> };

const Day = z.string().regex(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/, "must be a UTC day");

/**
 * What an order's notice is rendered from (10.4, W.2), built by the API at every read from the decision's row, its item's
 * and the order's as they stand, so the notice grows without a new decision. `verified` says whether order-verify has
 * run (until then the lead says only that the order names that authority); `orderedOn` is the day of the order's own
 * time stamp (`orderedFrom` issued) or of its receipt (received), or null; `held` whether the notice was held, and
 * `informedAt` the one instant the author was told (the release, for a held one); `holdEndReason` a hold ended by hand.
 * `preserveUntil` is the preservation's end as it stands, and (3f's review, people6) `preserveFirstUntil` its end six months
 * and a day from the disabling it counts from, before any extension; the two differ only once the preservation was extended.
 */
export const OrderNoticeFacts = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"]),
  memberState: MemberStateCode,
  authority: z.string(),
  reference: z.string(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  orderedOn: Day.nullable(),
  orderedFrom: z.enum(["issued", "received"]).nullable(),
  crossBorder: z.boolean(),
  homeState: MemberStateCode.nullable(),
  withholdAuthor: z.boolean(),
  disabledAt: At,
  held: z.boolean(),
  informedAt: At.nullable(),
  holdEndReason: z.enum(HOLD_END_REASONS).nullable(),
  preserveUntil: At.nullable(),
  preserveFirstUntil: At.nullable(),
  preserveExtended: z.boolean(),
  preserveEndedOn: Day.nullable(),
  orderGround: z.enum(ORDER_GROUNDS).nullable(),
});
export type OrderNoticeFacts = z.infer<typeof OrderNoticeFacts>;

/** The authority's words as the command line recorded them, read fresh, and since when the author holds the newest (10.4). */
export const OrderTexts = z.object({
  reasons: z.string().nullable(),
  redress: z.string().nullable(),
  scope: z.string().nullable(),
  textsAt: At.nullable(),
  // 3f's review (people2): since when the author holds the reasons themselves: the newest record of the reasons, or the
  // telling when that is later; null without reasons. A later record of the remedies or the scope moves textsAt only.
  reasonsAt: At.nullable(),
});
export type OrderTexts = z.infer<typeof OrderTexts>;

/** Home's [home.unverified] (10.2): the orders with a disabled item that are not verified, or whose disabled item was added after the check. */
export const OrdersUnverified = z.object({ total: z.number().int().nonnegative(), items: z.array(z.object({ orderId: z.uuid(), effectAt: At })).max(100) });
export type OrdersUnverified = z.infer<typeof OrdersUnverified>;

/**
 * Task 5 (sections 7.13 and 10.2): what `reports_owed()` answers and nothing more, for Home's [home.owed]: each owed
 * notification record's case, its kind (`sealed_images` for a seal's record, otherwise its first duty) and since when.
 * Who was reported to whom is the command line's alone.
 */
export const REPORT_OWED_KINDS = ["sealed_images", ...NOTIFICATION_DUTIES] as const;
export const ReportsOwed = z.object({
  total: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  items: z.array(z.object({ caseId: z.uuid(), kind: z.enum(REPORT_OWED_KINDS), since: At })).max(100),
});
export type ReportsOwed = z.infer<typeof ReportsOwed>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- recovery (sections 6.6, 7.16, 7.17 and 10.1; Task 6)

/**
 * What an import after a restore found lost, by class, in the order in which a person takes it again (7.17, row 38): an
 * order's disablings, seals for good, seals taken while deciding, suspensions and terminations, other restrictions,
 * reversals, decisions without a measure (for reference), and the records the import could only note. The one list of
 * the CHECK on restore_gaps.class, of the import, of the console's After a restore screen and of the home screen's count.
 */
export const GAP_CLASSES = ["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "release", "standing", "restriction", "reversal", "no_measure", "record"] as const;
export type GapClass = (typeof GAP_CLASSES)[number];
/** How a gap was closed: by a decision that took the measure again, by an admin as not needed, or as a record written again. */
export const GAP_DISPOSITIONS = ["reapplied", "not_needed", "imported"] as const;
export type GapDisposition = (typeof GAP_DISPOSITIONS)[number];
/**
 * The lost measures: while one of them is open, retention and the image sweep stay off (7.17 step 8). 3d's `release` (a
 * lost release, a lost leave or a lost withdrawal of one, which the operator replays or records again) is no measure, so
 * the list names its five classes rather than taking a slice of GAP_CLASSES, in which `release` stands fourth.
 */
export const GAP_MEASURE_CLASSES: readonly GapClass[] = ["order_effect", "seal_final", "seal_interim", "standing", "restriction"];
/**
 * The classes 1 to 4: while one of them is open, the app's site stays closed (RestoreView.mayOpen). 3d design, sections
 * 7.3 and 8.7: a `release` gap keeps it closed too, since until the replay the restored database counts as sealed and
 * kept what the record says was released. They are the first four of GAP_CLASSES, so the import's "gaps 1 to n" holds.
 */
export const GAP_SITE_CLASSES: readonly GapClass[] = GAP_CLASSES.slice(0, 4);

/** The most rows one download of the audit log's tail holds (7.16): a longer log is taken in several downloads. */
export const AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX = 50_000;
