    }or when your appeal is answered and the decision kept. Nothing is deleted while your appeal or your reply is unanswered.`,
  terminateLeave:
    "Until then you can export your data in Settings, Account. You can also delete the account yourself sooner; that ends your appeal with it, since nothing is left to restore. After the deletion korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images that korbat sealed, if it sealed any of yours, stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
  /** A termination's `stops` and `explore`: from its start, and Explore's first sentence alone, since it has no end. */
  stopsFromStart:
    "From its start you cannot post, reply, quote, like, repost, bookmark, follow, edit your profile, change your handle, upload images, ask for the verified badge, or report under korbat's rules.",
  exploreFromStart: "From its start your posts do not appear in Explore, and your likes and reposts of other people's posts do not count there.",
  /** A lift signed `replaced`, in place of the reversal's lead and liftedBefore; the last sentence only when the person had replied. */
  withdrawn: (what: "suspension" | "termination", decidedAt: string, replied: boolean) =>
    `korbat withdrew the ${what} it announced on ${decidedAt}, because it is taking another measure on your account.${replied ? " This is not a decision on your reply." : ""}`,
  /** The lead of a kept answer to a reply. */
  replyKept: (decided: string) => `korbat read your reply to its decision of ${decided} and keeps that decision.`,
  /** After a kept answer to a reply sent before the start: the start and end this answer fixes. */
  replyKeptOnTime: {
    suspension: (days: number, startsAt: string, endsAt: string) =>
      `The suspension of ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} starts at ${startsAt} and ends at ${endsAt}: with this answer, and never before the time you were first given.`,
    termination: (startsAt: string) => `The termination starts at ${startsAt}: with this answer, and never before the time you were first given.`,
  },
  /** After a kept answer to a reply sent after the start, by where the period stood: it goes on, or it had ended. */
  replyKeptLate: {
    running: (endsAt: string) => `The suspension goes on and ends at ${endsAt}, as before.`,
    ended: (endedAt: string) => `The suspension ended at ${endedAt}, as decided.`,
    termination: "The termination stays.",
  },
  /** The lead of a correction that answers a reply by reversing the measure, in place of `corrected`. */
  replyReversed: (decided: string, part: boolean) => `korbat read your reply to its decision of ${decided} and ${part ? "reversed part of that decision" : "reversed that decision"}.`,
  /** After a review's lead, when the review also answers the reply. */
  replyAlso: (filedAt: string) => `This also answers your reply of ${filedAt}.`,
  /** What the software did for a measure of the ladder: it counted what the measure rests on and listed the account. */
  automationCounted: "korbat's software counted what this rests on and listed your account for a moderator. A moderator read it and decided; no automated means decided it.",
  // 3e (design, section 18, W.2, Task 5): the warning about reporting and the restriction of it, what both leave open, a
  // restriction that ended with its warning, and the lift of either. The counts and the marked reports are the facts'
  // (STANDING_DRAFTS, W.5), worded by the moment the console read them, never a sentence here.
  /** A warning: that it restricts nothing, and until when it counts. Then the redress version's warnNext. */
  warn: (endsAt: string) =>
    `korbat warns you about your reports. Nothing is restricted. The facts below say how many of your reports under korbat's rules a moderator marked as manifestly unfounded, and which. This warning counts until ${endsAt}.`,
  /** A restriction: its days and end (its start, the decision's time, plus its days), and the warning it follows. */
  restrict: (days: number, endsAt: string, warnedAt: string) =>
    `korbat restricted your reports under its rules for ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, until ${endsAt}: until then it takes no report from your account that says something breaks a korbat rule. It follows korbat's warning of ${warnedAt}, and ends at once if that warning is lifted; the facts below name the reports you sent after it that were marked.`,
  /** After either reporting measure: what neither ever counts or restricts (DSA Art. 16(6)). */
  reportingOpen: "Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination are never counted and never restricted.",
  /** A restriction of reporting whose warning this decision lifted: the restriction, then where its days stood. */
  basisEndedReporting: (decidedAt: string) => `The restriction of your reports that korbat decided on ${decidedAt} rested on that warning.`,
  basisEndedReportingThen: {
    running: "It ended with this decision: you can report under korbat's rules again.",
    ended: (startedAt: string, endedAt: string) => `It had run from ${startedAt} to ${endedAt}.`,
  },
  /** The lift of a reporting measure: a warning, a restriction that ran, or one whose days had already run out. */
  reportingLifted: {
    warning: "korbat lifted its warning about your reports: it no longer counts.",
    restriction: "korbat lifted the restriction of your reports: you can report under korbat's rules again.",
    restrictionEnded: (endedAt: string) => `korbat lifted the restriction of your reports that ran until ${endedAt}.`,
  },
  /**
   * The rule or the law, worded by what korbat knows when it decides. A decision that seals rests on a report that nobody
   * at korbat has checked against the images, since nobody opens them, so it says what the step rests on and never that
   * the rule is broken or the content illegal. A decision taken while deciding says what korbat is checking. Only a final
   * restriction without a seal states a finding. A review or a correction names the ground of the decision it is about.
   */
  ground: {
    sealRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `This step rests on korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    sealLaw: (reference: string) => `This step rests on the law: ${reference}`,
    checkingRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `korbat is checking this against korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    checkingLaw: (reference: string) => `korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: ${reference}`,
    breaks: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `It breaks korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    illegal: (reference: string) => `korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: ${reference}`,
    restedOnRule: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `That decision rested on korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    // 3e's review (people1): a review, a correction, a lift or an answer to a reply about a measure of the ladder or a
    // protective suspension, which rested on the terms' section and found no breach of the rule its decision cited.
    restedOnTerms: "That decision rested on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination.",
    restedOnLaw: (reference: string) => `That decision rested on the law: ${reference}`,
    referenceErased: "its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
    // 3e (W.2, "The rule or the term"): a protective suspension rests on the terms' clause, never on a finding under R2; a
    // measure taken at once on a threat or a flood names the account's conduct. The 14 days are a literal of these words,
    // held to STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays by the rules package's table test.
    protective: (title: string) =>
      `This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination: when korbat keeps images of an account sealed after a report of child sexual abuse material, an admin may suspend the account once, for up to 14 days. The rule such a report is made under is korbat rule R2, "${title}". korbat has not found that your account broke it.`,
    conduct: (id: string, title: string, text: string) => `Your account's conduct breaks korbat rule ${id}, "${title}": ${text}`,
    // 3e Task 4: a measure of the ladder finds no new breach. It rests on the terms' section, and names the rule of the
    // newest strike as that and nothing more. The numbers are literals of these words, held to STANDING_RULES
    // (ladderStrikes, the rungs and ladderMemoryDays) by the rules package's table test.
    ladder: (id: string, title: string) =>
      `This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination: an account with 3 active strikes may be suspended for a limited time. This decision finds no new breach. The newest of the strikes it rests on was given under korbat rule ${id}, "${title}".`,
    ladderEnd: (id: string, title: string) =>
      `This rests on korbat's terms, section Suspension and termination: after three suspensions in 365 days an account with 3 active strikes may be terminated. This decision finds no new breach. The newest of the strikes it rests on was given under korbat rule ${id}, "${title}".`,
  },
} as const;

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;

/**
 * When the holder of a retired handle may choose a new one without the usual wait (3e design, W.2), read from the
 * decision's own measures so that the sentence reads as it was sent: at once; after a suspension the same decision
 * takes at once (a suspended account changes no handle); never after a termination taken at once. An announced
 * suspension or termination has not started when the decision is sent, so the handle can be chosen at once.
 */
export type RetireEnd = "at_once" | "after_suspension" | "none";
export function retireEnd(measures: readonly StatementInput["measures"][number][]): RetireEnd {
  if (measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "terminate" && measure.announced === false)) return "none";
  if (measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" && measure.announced === false)) return "after_suspension";
  return "at_once";
}

/**
 * The sentence that names the source: a notice or a report was followed, a moderator's finding was found; 3d Task 6: or
 * an automated check found it, for a decision of korbat's own initiative whose detection was automated.
 */
const sourceSentence = (source: StatementInput["source"], automated = false): string => {
  // 3f: an order decision is a notice and never reaches this sentence (statementParagraphs returns its notice first).
  if (source === "order") throw new Error("an order's decision is a notice, not a statement of reasons");
  if (source === "own_initiative") return `What this decision is about was ${automated ? W.source.automated : W.source.own_initiative}.`;
  return `korbat decided this ${W.source[source]}.`;
};

/** 3d Task 7: a match's three facts a statement prints; a match whose record is gone reads as a flag of an unnamed source. */
function matchFacts(signal: NonNullable<StatementInput["signal"]>): { source: string; listedAs: "csam" | "other"; matchKind: "exact" | "near" } {
  return { source: signal.source ?? "the source", listedAs: signal.listedAs ?? "other", matchKind: signal.matchKind ?? "near" };
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, section 7.10's table): the automation paragraph of a person's decision whose detection was
 * automated, read from the decision's own columns and its signal, so it reads as sent. A score's paragraph ends by
 * whether the record shows that the person opened the image (`viewed`); a match's and a partly automated decision's are
 * the known material's sentences, which this version does not hold yet.
 */
function automatedFoundParagraph(input: StatementInput): string {
  // 3d Task 7: a match's paragraph: partly automated when an admin restricted on it unseen, else found by a program and
  // decided by a person, each with the comparison and what korbat has not assessed.
  if (input.signal?.kind === "known_match") {
    const match = matchFacts(input.signal);
    const comparison = W.automated.comparison(match.listedAs, match.matchKind, match.source);
    const paragraph = input.automatedDecision === "partially" ? W.automated.partly(comparison) : W.automated.found.match(comparison);
    return `${paragraph} ${W.automated.notAssessed(match.listedAs, match.matchKind)}`;
  }
  if (input.automatedDecision === "partially" || input.signal?.kind !== "r1_score") {
    throw new Error("a statement's automated finding names no signal that this version of @korbat/rules words");
  }
  const found = input.signal.viewed === true ? W.automated.found.r1.viewed : W.automated.found.r1.unviewed;
  return input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "strike") ? `${found} ${W.automated.strikeRule}` : found;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and W.3): the statement of a decision without a decider, a program's, in its own order:
 * what was done; where and for how long; how long it lasts and what a program does not do; the source; the automation
 * paragraph that says that automated means found this and took the measure; the rule it was taken under; and "Ask for a
 * person" in the place of the interim redress. It has no facts and no reason: no person wrote one, and the automation
 * paragraph states the facts the measure rests on (DSA Art. 17(3)(b), (c)). A match's words are Task 7's.
 */
function programParagraphs(input: StatementInput, redress: RedressTexts): string[] {
  if (input.signal === null || input.signal === undefined || input.ruleId === null) throw new Error("a program's measure names its signal and its rule");
  const rule = getRule(input.ruleId, input.rulesVersion);
  if (!rule) throw new Error(`a statement cites ${input.ruleId} of rulebook version ${input.rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
  // 3d Task 7 (W.3, W.4): a program's seal on a match: the seal, its scope, until an admin answers, the source, the
  // automation paragraph with the comparison and what korbat has not assessed, the rule, and "Ask for a person" worded
  // for an admin.
  if (input.signal.kind === "known_match") {
    if (redress.askAdmin === undefined) throw new Error(`a program's seal needs "Ask for a person" for an admin, which redress version ${input.redressVersion} does not hold`);
    const match = matchFacts(input.signal);
    return [
      ...input.measures.map((measure) => measureParagraph(input, measure, redress)),
      W.scope.interim,
      W.automated.until.match,
      sourceSentence(input.source, true),
      W.automated.fully.match(W.automated.comparison(match.listedAs, match.matchKind, match.source)),
      W.automated.notAssessed(match.listedAs, match.matchKind),
      W.automated.ground(rule.id, rule.title, rule.text),
      redress.askAdmin,
    ];
  }
  if (redress.askPerson === undefined) throw new Error(`a program's statement needs "Ask for a person", which redress version ${input.redressVersion} does not hold`);
  return [
    ...input.measures.map((measure) => measureParagraph(input, measure, redress)),
    W.scope.interim,
    W.automated.until.r1,
    sourceSentence(input.source, true),
    W.automated.fully.r1,
    W.automated.ground(rule.id, rule.title, rule.text),
    redress.askPerson,
  ];
}

/** What a reset's end or lifting says of the field: korbat does not put the old value back, and where it can still be read. */
function fieldSentence(field: Field, reset: { oldValueKept: boolean; resetRuleId: string | null }): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.field(field)];
  if (reset.oldValueKept) parts.push(reset.resetRuleId === "R4" ? W.oldValueKeptR4 : W.oldValueKept);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/**
 * The kinds whose sentences this version of the package does not hold yet: none is rendered as another one. Since 3e's
 * reporting measures were worded (Task 5) every kind is; a kind a later sub-project adds to the ledger waits here until
 * its sentences exist.
 */
const UNWORDED: readonly (MeasureKind | ReversalKind)[] = [];

/** A decision's reporting measure (a warning or a restriction of reporting), if it holds one. */
const reportingOf = (input: StatementInput) => input.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "warn_reporting" || measure.kind === "restrict_reporting");

/**
 * A warning or a restriction of reporting, as a paragraph (3e design, W.2): what it is and until when, the warning's
 * prior word of what may follow (from the decision's own redress version), and what neither ever counts or restricts.
 */
function reportingParagraph(measure: StatementInput["measures"][number], redress: RedressTexts): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (measure.kind === "warn_reporting") {
    if (measure.endsAt === undefined || measure.endsAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's warn_reporting names its end of counting: the decision's data holds none");
    parts.push(W.warn(utcMinute(measure.endsAt)));
    if (redress.warnNext === undefined) throw new Error("a statement's warning needs the redress text of what may follow, which this redress version does not hold");
    parts.push(redress.warnNext);
  } else {
    const { days, endsAt, warnedAt } = measure;
    if (days === undefined || days === null || endsAt === undefined || endsAt === null || warnedAt === undefined || warnedAt === null) {
      throw new Error("a statement's restrict_reporting names its days, its end and the warning it follows: the decision's data holds none");
    }
    parts.push(W.restrict(days, utcMinute(endsAt), utcMinute(warnedAt)));
  }
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedAccount);
  parts.push(W.reportingOpen);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** The lift of a reporting measure: the warning, or the restriction by whether its days still ran at this decision's time. */
function reportingLiftParagraph(reversal: StatementInput["reversals"][number]): string {
  if (reversal.liftedKind === "warn_reporting") return W.reportingLifted.warning;
  if (reversal.liftedKind !== "restrict_reporting") throw new Error("a statement's lift_reporting names the warning or the restriction it lifts: the decision's data holds neither");
  if (reversal.periodThen?.state === "ended") {
    if (reversal.periodThen.endedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's lift of a restriction that had run out names its end");
    return W.reportingLifted.restrictionEnded(utcMinute(reversal.periodThen.endedAt));
  }
  return W.reportingLifted.restriction;
}

/** What a sentence calls a standing measure. */
const standingWord = (kind: "suspend" | "terminate"): "suspension" | "termination" => (kind === "terminate" ? "termination" : "suspension");

/** A decision's standing measure (a suspension or a termination), if it holds one: a decision holds at most one. */
const standingOf = (input: StatementInput) => input.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");

/** The strikes a measure of the ladder rests on, as `restsOn` lists them: "the strike of {decidedAt} under rule {ruleId} (your post of {postCreatedAt})", joined by "; ". */
function strikeList(measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string {
  const entries = measure.restsOn ?? [];
  if (entries.length === 0) throw new Error("a statement's measure of the ladder names the strikes it rests on: the decision's data holds none");
  return entries
    .map((entry) => {
      if (entry.ruleId === null) throw new Error("a strike a measure of the ladder rests on names its rule");
      // The ledger always knows the post; the console's preview, which reads the account's strikes without their posts, does not.
      return W.restsOnEntry(utcMinute(entry.decidedAt), entry.ruleId, entry.postCreatedAt === null ? null : utcMinute(entry.postCreatedAt));
    })
    .join("; ");
}

/** The hours between an announced measure's decision and its earliest start: the reply window its statement names. */
function windowHours(decidedAt: string, earliestStart: string): number {
  return Math.round((Date.parse(earliestStart) - Date.parse(decidedAt)) / 3_600_000);
}

/**
 * An announced suspension, as four paragraphs (3e design, W.2): that korbat will suspend the account and the strikes it
 * rests on; when it starts; what it stops and what it leaves; and what it does to Explore.
 */
function announcedSuspendParagraphs(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string[] {
  const { days, earliestStart } = measure;
  if (days === undefined || days === null || earliestStart === undefined || earliestStart === null) throw new Error("an announced suspend names its days and its earliest start: the decision's data holds neither");
  const lead = [W.suspendAnnounced(days), W.restsOn(strikeList(measure))];
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") lead.push(W.deletedAccount);
  return [lead.join(" "), W.start("It", windowHours(input.decidedAt, earliestStart), utcMinute(earliestStart)), `${W.stops} ${W.stays}`, W.explore];
}

/**
 * A termination, as five paragraphs (3e design, W.2): what was done (announced at the ladder's end with its strikes and
 * its start, or at once on a second threat with the two decisions it rests on); what it waits for before the account is
 * deleted; what the person can do until then; what it stops and leaves from its start; and Explore.
 */
function terminateParagraphs(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string[] {
  const deadline = utcMinute(appealDeadline(new Date(input.decidedAt)));
  const lead: string[] = [];
  if (measure.announced === true) {
    if (measure.earliestStart === undefined || measure.earliestStart === null) throw new Error("an announced terminate names its earliest start: the decision's data holds none");
    lead.push(W.terminateAnnounced(strikeList(measure)), W.start("The termination", windowHours(input.decidedAt, measure.earliestStart), utcMinute(measure.earliestStart)));
  } else {
    // On threat_repeat the two R5 decisions, the earlier first: the one the earlier suspension rests on, then the new one.
    const [earlier, newer] = measure.restsOn ?? [];
    if (earlier === undefined || newer === undefined) throw new Error("a terminate at once names the two decisions it rests on: the decision's data holds none");
    lead.push(W.terminateAtOnce(utcMinute(newer.decidedAt), utcMinute(earlier.decidedAt)));
  }
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") lead.push(W.deletedAccount);
  return [lead.join(" "), W.terminateWait(deadline, measure.announced === true), W.terminateLeave, `${W.stopsFromStart} ${W.stays}`, W.exploreFromStart];
}

/**
 * A suspension taken at once, as three paragraphs (3e design, W.2): what was done, until when, and why at once (with the
 * decision or the seal it rests on, read from the ledger's row), and that it changes nothing for a deleted account; what
 * it stops and what it leaves; and what it does to Explore. An announced one has paragraphs of its own.
 */
function suspendParagraphs(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string[] {
  if (measure.announced === true) return announcedSuspendParagraphs(input, measure);
  if (measure.announced !== false) throw new Error("a statement's suspend says whether it was announced: the decision's data does not");
  const { days, endsAt, basis, restsOn } = measure;
  if (days === undefined || days === null || endsAt === undefined || endsAt === null || basis === undefined || basis === null) {
    throw new Error("a statement's suspend names its days, its end and its basis: the decision's data holds none");
  }
  const rested = restsOn?.[0]?.decidedAt;
  let why: string;
  if (basis === "flood") why = W.basis.flood;
  else if ((basis === "threat" || basis === "terrorist" || basis === "protective") && rested !== undefined) why = W.basis[basis](utcMinute(rested));
  else throw new Error(`a statement's suspend at once on the basis ${basis} names the decision it rests on: the decision's data holds none`);
  const lead = [W.suspendAtOnce(days, utcMinute(endsAt)), why];
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") lead.push(W.deletedAccount);
  return [lead.join(" "), `${W.stops} ${W.stays}`, W.explore];
}

/**
 * The lift of a suspension, by where its period stood at this decision's time. A withdrawal signed `replaced` says that
 * korbat withdrew the announced measure for another one, and that this is no decision on the person's reply when they
 * had sent one, in place of the reversal's lead and of liftedBefore.
 */
function liftParagraph(reversal: StatementInput["reversals"][number]): string {
  const { liftedKind, periodThen } = reversal;
  if ((liftedKind !== "suspend" && liftedKind !== "terminate") || periodThen === undefined || periodThen === null) {
    throw new Error("a statement's lift_suspension names the measure it lifts and its period then: the decision's data holds neither");
  }
  const what = standingWord(liftedKind);
  if (reversal.replaced === true) {
    if (reversal.liftedDecidedAt === undefined || reversal.liftedDecidedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's withdrawal names the withdrawn decision's time: the decision's data holds none");
    return W.withdrawn(what, utcMinute(reversal.liftedDecidedAt), reversal.replyFiledAt !== undefined && reversal.replyFiledAt !== null);
  }
  if (periodThen.state === "not_started") {
    if (reversal.liftedDecidedAt === undefined || reversal.liftedDecidedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's lift_suspension before the start names the lifted decision's time: the decision's data holds none");
    return W.liftedBefore(what, utcMinute(reversal.liftedDecidedAt));
  }
  if (periodThen.state === "running") return W.liftedRunning(what);
  // A termination has no end, so it has no form for one that had already ended.
  if (liftedKind === "terminate" || periodThen.startedAt === null || periodThen.endedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's lift_suspension of a period that ended names its start and its end");
  return W.liftedEnded(utcMinute(periodThen.startedAt), utcMinute(periodThen.endedAt));
}

/** A standing measure whose basis this decision broke: what it rested on, where its period stood, and a reply that waited. */
function basisEndedParagraph(entry: NonNullable<StatementInput["endedStanding"]>[number]): string {
  const { periodThen } = entry;
  if (entry.kind === "restrict_reporting") {
    // A restriction of reporting ends with the warning this decision lifted; one whose days had run out says when it ran.
    if (periodThen.state === "ended") {
      if (periodThen.startedAt === null || periodThen.endedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's ended restriction names its start and its end");
      return `${W.basisEndedReporting(utcMinute(entry.decidedAt))} ${W.basisEndedReportingThen.ended(utcMinute(periodThen.startedAt), utcMinute(periodThen.endedAt))}`;
    }
    return `${W.basisEndedReporting(utcMinute(entry.decidedAt))} ${W.basisEndedReportingThen.running}`;
  }
  let then: string;
  if (periodThen.state === "ended") {
    if (periodThen.startedAt === null || periodThen.endedAt === null) throw new Error("a statement's ended period names its start and its end");
    then = W.basisEndedThen.ended(utcMinute(periodThen.startedAt), utcMinute(periodThen.endedAt));
  } else then = W.basisEndedThen[periodThen.state];
  const parts = [W.basisEnded(standingWord(entry.kind), utcMinute(entry.decidedAt), entry.seal), then];
  if (entry.replyFiledAt !== null) parts.push(W.basisEndedReply(utcMinute(entry.replyFiledAt)));
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/**
 * A retirement, as a paragraph. One that changed the profile names the handle, its placeholder and when a new handle can be
 * chosen; one that changed nothing names the handle and why, and no placeholder, since none was written.
 */
function retireParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number]): string {
  const { handle, placeholder } = measure;
  if (handle === undefined || handle === null) throw new Error("a statement's retire_handle names the handle it retired: the decision's data holds none");
  if (measure.noEffect === "already") return `${W.retireLead(handle)} ${W.retireAlready}`;
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") return `${W.retireLead(handle)} ${W.deletedAccount}`;
  if (placeholder === undefined || placeholder === null) throw new Error("a statement's retire_handle names the placeholder it gave: the decision's data holds none");
  return W.retire(handle, placeholder, retireEnd(input.measures));
}

/**
 * A strike, as a paragraph: that the decision gives one, until when it counts and how many counted with it; that it
 * counts although the post was already not shown or deleted, when every other measure of the decision changed nothing;
 * then the prior warning of what strikes lead to, from the decision's own redress version.
 */
function strikeParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number], redress: RedressTexts): string {
  if (measure.endsAt === undefined || measure.endsAt === null || measure.activeThen === undefined || measure.activeThen === null) {
    throw new Error("a statement's strike names its end of counting and the strikes active then: the decision's data holds neither");
  }
  const parts: string[] = [W.strike(utcMinute(measure.endsAt), measure.activeThen)];
  const others = input.measures.filter((other) => other.kind !== "strike");
  if (others.length > 0 && others.every((other) => other.noEffect !== null)) parts.push(W.strikeAnyway);
  // Redress version 1 has no prior warning, and no decision under it holds a strike.
  if (redress.strikeNext !== undefined) parts.push(redress.strikeNext);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One measure, as a paragraph: what was done, then that it changed nothing when it did not. */
function measureParagraph(input: StatementInput, measure: StatementInput["measures"][number], redress: RedressTexts): string {
  const post = input.post === null ? null : utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  const deciding = input.kind === "interim";
  if (UNWORDED.includes(measure.kind)) throw new Error(`a statement's ${measure.kind} is not worded in this version of @korbat/rules`);
  if (measure.kind === "strike") return strikeParagraph(input, measure, redress);
  if (measure.kind === "retire_handle") return retireParagraph(input, measure);
  if (measure.kind === "warn_reporting" || measure.kind === "restrict_reporting") return reportingParagraph(measure, redress);
  const field = fieldOf(measure.kind);
  if (measure.kind === "seal_media") {
    const sealed = measure.sealed ?? { posts: 0, images: 0, deletedImages: 0 };
    const parts: string[] = [post === null ? W.sealAccount(sealed.images, sealed.posts) : W.sealPost(post, sealed.images)];
    if (post === null && sealed.deletedImages > 0) parts.push(W.sealDeleted(sealed.deletedImages));
    if (input.kind === "final") parts.push(W.sealForGood);
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadySealed);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(post === null ? W.deletedAccount : W.deletedPost);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (field !== null) {
    const parts: string[] = [W.done.reset(field, deciding)];
    // A reset that changed something wrote the placeholder; one that changed nothing wrote nothing, and says so.
    if (measure.noEffect === null) parts.push(W.resetOnce(field));
    if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.alreadyField);
    if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedAccount);
    return parts.join(" ");
  }
  if (post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${measure.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const done = measure.kind === "withhold" ? W.done.withhold(post) : measure.kind === "remove" ? W.done.remove(post) : measure.kind === "withhold_media" ? W.done.withhold_media(post) : W.done.remove_media(post);
  const parts: string[] = [done];
  if (measure.noEffect === "already") parts.push(W.already(MEASURES[measure.kind].target === "image" ? "image" : "post"));
  if (measure.noEffect === "deleted") parts.push(W.deletedPost);
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/** One reversal, as a paragraph. A lifted restriction of a post or an image names the post. */
function reversalParagraph(input: StatementInput, reversal: StatementInput["reversals"][number]): string {
  if (UNWORDED.includes(reversal.kind)) throw new Error(`a statement's ${reversal.kind} is not worded in this version of @korbat/rules`);
  if (reversal.kind === "overrule") return W.overruled;
  if (reversal.kind === "lift_suspension") return liftParagraph(reversal);
  if (reversal.kind === "lift_reporting") return reportingLiftParagraph(reversal);
  if (reversal.kind === "unretire_handle") {
    if (reversal.handle === undefined || reversal.handle === null) throw new Error("a statement's unretire_handle names the handle it gives back: the decision's data holds none");
    return W.unretired(reversal.handle);
  }
  const field = fieldOf(reversal.kind);
  if (field !== null) return `${W.liftedField(field)} ${fieldSentence(field, reversal)}`;
  if (reversal.kind === "unseal_media") return W.unsealed;
  if (input.post === null) throw new Error(`a statement's ${reversal.kind} names its post: the decision's data holds none`);
  const post = utcMinute(input.post.createdAt);
  return `${reversal.kind === "restore_media" ? `One image of your post of ${post}` : `Your post of ${post}`}: ${W.lifted}`;
}

/** The measures taken while deciding that ended with the decision, and what becomes of each reset field the decision does not reset itself. */
function endedParagraph(input: StatementInput): string {
  const parts: string[] = [W.ended(input.endedMeasures.map((ended) => MEASURES[ended.kind].label).join(", "))];
  for (const ended of input.endedMeasures) {
    const field = fieldOf(ended.kind);
    if (field !== null && !input.measures.some((measure) => fieldOf(measure.kind) === field)) parts.push(fieldSentence(field, ended));
  }
  return parts.join(" ");
}

/**
 * How a ground is worded (STATEMENT_WORDS.ground): for the decision a review or a correction is about; for a decision
 * that seals; for one taken while deciding; or for a final restriction without a seal, the only one that states a finding.
 */
type GroundForm = "about" | "seal" | "deciding" | "found" | "conduct";

/** The rule or the law a decision rests on, in the form that fits what the decision is. */
function groundParagraph(ground: { ground: StatementInput["ground"]; ruleId: string | null; legalReference: string | null }, rulesVersion: number, form: GroundForm): string | null {
  const G = W.ground;
  if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
    const reference = ground.legalReference ?? G.referenceErased;
    return form === "about" ? G.restedOnLaw(reference) : form === "seal" ? G.sealLaw(reference) : form === "deciding" ? G.checkingLaw(reference) : G.illegal(reference);
  }
  if (ground.ground === "incompatible" && ground.ruleId !== null) {
    const rule = getRule(ground.ruleId, rulesVersion);
    // A decision records the version it was made under, and every version is kept: one that is missing is never rendered as another.
    if (!rule) throw new Error(`a statement cites ${ground.ruleId} of rulebook version ${rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
    const words = form === "about" ? G.restedOnRule : form === "seal" ? G.sealRule : form === "deciding" ? G.checkingRule : form === "conduct" ? G.conduct : G.breaks;
    return words(rule.id, rule.title, rule.text);
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * 3e (W.2): the second sentence of an answer to a reply that leaves the measure in force, by whether the reply came
 * before the start and, after a late one, where the period stood: the start and end a kept answer fixes; that a running
 * suspension goes on, or that an ended one ended as decided; that a termination stays.
 */
function replyKeptSentence(replied: NonNullable<StatementInput["repliedTo"]>): string {
  if (replied.onTime) {
    if (replied.startsAt === null) throw new Error("a kept answer to a reply before the start names the start it fixes: the decision's data holds none");
    if (replied.kind === "terminate") return W.replyKeptOnTime.termination(utcMinute(replied.startsAt));
    if (replied.days === null || replied.endsAt === null) throw new Error("a kept answer to a reply names the suspension's days and end: the decision's data holds neither");
    return W.replyKeptOnTime.suspension(replied.days, utcMinute(replied.startsAt), utcMinute(replied.endsAt));
  }
  if (replied.kind === "terminate") return W.replyKeptLate.termination;
  if (replied.periodThen.state === "ended") {
    if (replied.periodThen.endedAt === null) throw new Error("a kept answer to a reply after an ended suspension names its end");
    return W.replyKeptLate.ended(utcMinute(replied.periodThen.endedAt));
  }
  if (replied.endsAt === null) throw new Error("a kept answer to a reply after the start names the suspension's end");
  return W.replyKeptLate.running(utcMinute(replied.endsAt));
}

/**
 * The lead of a review or a correction: which decision it is about, by its time, and what became of it. 3e: a correction
 * that answers a reply leads with that answer (kept with the start or the state it leaves, or reversed); a review that
 * answers one adds that it does, and what it leaves; a withdrawal signed `replaced` has no lead of its own, since its
 * lift's sentence says what it did.
 */
function aboutLead(input: StatementInput): string | null {
  const decided = utcMinute(input.reviewed!.decidedAt);
  const replied = input.repliedTo;
  if (input.kind === "review") {
    const lead = W.reviewed(decided, input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : input.outcome === "partly_reversed" ? "partly_reversed" : "reversed");
    if (replied === undefined) return lead;
    // The review leaves the measure in force when it keeps the decision, or reverses part of it without the lift.
    const stays = input.outcome === "kept" || (input.outcome === "partly_reversed" && !input.reversals.some((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension"));
    return [lead, W.replyAlso(utcMinute(replied.filedAt)), ...(stays ? [replyKeptSentence(replied)] : [])].join(" ");
  }
  if (input.reviewed!.kind === "interim") return W.interimLifted(decided);
  if (replied !== undefined) return input.outcome === "kept" ? `${W.replyKept(decided)} ${replyKeptSentence(replied)}` : W.replyReversed(decided, input.outcome === "partly_reversed");
  if (input.reversals.some((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension" && reversal.replaced === true)) return null;
  return W.corrected(decided, input.outcome === "partly_reversed");
}

/** The paragraph of the rule or the term of a decision that holds a measure of the ladder: the terms' section, and the newest strike's rule named as that. */
function ladderGround(input: StatementInput, basis: "strikes" | "ladder_end"): string {
  if (input.ruleId === null) throw new Error("a measure of the ladder cites the rule of the newest strike: the decision's data holds none");
  const rule = getRule(input.ruleId, input.rulesVersion);
  if (!rule) throw new Error(`a statement cites ${input.ruleId} of rulebook version ${input.rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
  return basis === "strikes" ? W.ground.ladder(rule.id, rule.title) : W.ground.ladderEnd(rule.id, rule.title);
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons as paragraphs, in this order: what was done (one paragraph for each measure and each reversal,
 * then what ended); where it applies and for how long; how it came to korbat; that nothing was automated; the rule or the
 * law; the facts and the reason; and what the author can do about it.
 */
export function statementParagraphs(input: StatementInput, extras: OrderNoticeExtras = {}): string[] {
  const redress = getRedress(input.redressVersion);
  if (!redress) throw new Error(`a statement names the redress texts of version ${input.redressVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
  // 3f: an order decision and the correction of one are a notice, not a statement of reasons: none of the paragraphs
  // below (no rule, no facts, no reason of korbat's, no appeal) applies to it.
  if (input.order !== null && input.order !== undefined) return orderNoticeParagraphs(input, extras);
  // 3d Task 6: a program's decision has its own order and words.
  if (input.automatedDecision === "fully") return programParagraphs(input, redress);
  // Task 4: an order decision, or the correction of one, whose order's records were deleted: no order's facts are left,
  // and the notice says only that an order was given effect, and when.
  if (input.kind === "order" || (input.kind === "correction" && input.reviewed?.kind === "order")) return orderGoneParagraphs(input);
  const paragraphs: string[] = [];
  const about = input.kind === "review" || input.kind === "correction";
  const restricts = input.measures.length > 0;

  // What was done.
  if (about) {
    if (input.reviewed === null) throw new Error("the statement of a review or a correction names the decision it is about: the decision's data holds none");
    const lead = aboutLead(input);
    if (lead !== null) paragraphs.push(lead);
  }
  for (const measure of input.measures) {
    // 3e: a suspension and a termination are paragraphs of their own (what and why, when it starts, what it stops and
    // leaves, Explore, and for a termination what it waits for and leaves until the deletion).
    if (measure.kind === "suspend") paragraphs.push(...suspendParagraphs(input, measure));
    else if (measure.kind === "terminate") paragraphs.push(...terminateParagraphs(input, measure));
    else paragraphs.push(measureParagraph(input, measure, redress));
  }
  for (const reversal of input.reversals) paragraphs.push(reversalParagraph(input, reversal));
  if (input.endedMeasures.length > 0) paragraphs.push(endedParagraph(input));
  // 3e: the standing measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke.
  for (const entry of input.endedStanding ?? []) paragraphs.push(basisEndedParagraph(entry));
  if (paragraphs.length === 0) paragraphs.push(W.noAction);
  // 3f Task 6: a decision that took again one lost with a restore says so, with the lost day, after what it did.
  if (input.reapplied) paragraphs.push(W.reapplied(input.reapplied.lostOn));

  const standing = standingOf(input);
  const reporting = reportingOf(input);
  // Where and how long: only a decision that restricts has a scope; a suspension's is its days from its start, and a
  // termination's has no end; a restriction of reporting's runs until its end, and a warning restricts nothing.
  if (restricts) {
    paragraphs.push(
      input.kind === "interim"
        ? W.scope.interim
        : standing?.kind === "suspend" && typeof standing.days === "number"
          ? W.scope.suspend(standing.days)
          : standing?.kind === "terminate"
            ? W.scope.terminate
            : reporting?.kind === "restrict_reporting" && typeof reporting.endsAt === "string"
              ? W.scope.reporting(utcMinute(reporting.endsAt))
              : reporting?.kind === "warn_reporting"
                ? W.scope.warn
                : W.scope.final,
    );
    if (input.ground === "illegal") paragraphs.push(W.scope.law);
  }

  // How it came to korbat, for a decision of its own; a review or a correction is korbat's own second look. 3d Task 6: a
  // decision of korbat's own initiative whose detection was automated says that an automated check found it.
  if (!about) paragraphs.push(sourceSentence(input.source, input.automatedDetection === true));
  // A decision that gives a strike says what the software did: it applied korbat's published rule of when one is given.
  // A suspension on a flood rests on a count the software made, and a measure of the ladder on the strikes it counted and
  // the list it put the account on; one on a decision, a threat or a seal rests on nothing the software did, and keeps
  // 3c's sentence. A reporting measure rests on the reports the software counted and the list of reporting records.
  const counted = standing?.basis === "strikes" || standing?.basis === "ladder_end" || reporting !== undefined;
  // 3d Task 6: a decision whose detection was automated has the paragraph of what found it in the place of all four.
  paragraphs.push(
    input.automatedDetection === true
      ? automatedFoundParagraph(input)
      : input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "strike")
        ? W.automationStrike
        : standing?.basis === "flood"
          ? W.automationFlood
          : counted
            ? W.automationCounted
            : W.automation,
  );

  // The rule or the law: the decision's own, or for a review or a correction the reviewed decision's, from that decision's
  // row and in the wording of the rulebook that decision was made under. A decision that holds a standing measure names
  // the ground it truly rests on (3e, W.2): the terms' clause for a protective suspension, which never says that a rule is
  // broken; the terms' section for a measure of the ladder, which finds no new breach; and the account's conduct for one
  // taken at once on a threat or a flood (the law, as ever, on terrorist content).
  if (!about && standing?.basis === "protective") {
    const r2 = getRule("R2", input.rulesVersion);
    if (!r2) throw new Error(`a statement cites R2 of rulebook version ${input.rulesVersion}, which this package does not hold`);
    paragraphs.push(W.ground.protective(r2.title));
  } else if (!about && (standing?.basis === "strikes" || standing?.basis === "ladder_end")) {
    paragraphs.push(ladderGround(input, standing.basis));
  } else {
    // A reporting measure, like a measure at once, names the account's conduct under R6 (W.2, "The rule or the term").
    const form: GroundForm = about ? "about" : input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media") ? "seal" : input.kind === "interim" ? "deciding" : standing || reporting ? "conduct" : "found";
    // A decision about a measure that rested on the terms names the terms, never the rule its decision cited (W.2).
    const onTerms = about && (input.reviewed!.basis === "strikes" || input.reviewed!.basis === "ladder_end" || input.reviewed!.basis === "protective");
    const ground = onTerms ? W.ground.restedOnTerms : about ? groundParagraph(input.reviewed!, input.reviewed!.rulesVersion, form) : groundParagraph(input, input.rulesVersion, form);
    if (ground !== null) paragraphs.push(ground);
  }

  // The facts and the reason, while korbat keeps them.
  if (input.facts !== null) paragraphs.push(`The facts: ${input.facts}`);
  if (input.reason !== null) paragraphs.push(about ? `Why korbat ${input.outcome === "kept" ? "kept" : "changed"} it: ${input.reason}` : `korbat's reasons: ${input.reason}`);

  // Redress, from the decision's own kind and outcome.
  if (input.kind === "interim") paragraphs.push(redress.interim);
  else if (input.kind === "final" && input.outcome === "restricted") {
    // 3e (W.3): an announced measure can be replied to before its start, and appealed from now; one taken at once can be
    // replied to at any time while it runs. The reply comes before the appeal.
    if (standing !== undefined && standing.announced === true) {
      if (redress.reply === undefined) throw new Error(`a statement's announced measure needs the reply's text, which redress version ${input.redressVersion} does not hold`);
      paragraphs.push(redress.reply);
    }
    if (standing !== undefined && standing.announced === false) {
      if (redress.replyAtOnce === undefined) throw new Error(`a statement's measure taken at once needs the reply's text, which redress version ${input.redressVersion} does not hold`);
      paragraphs.push(redress.replyAtOnce);
    }
    // 3f's review (people3): the six months count from the telling, as the database's appeal_deadline counts them: a
    // decision held with an order's notice is told at the release, which can be weeks after it was taken.
    const appeal = redress.appeal.replace("{deadline}", () => utcMinute(appealDeadline(new Date(input.informedAt ?? input.decidedAt))));
    paragraphs.push(input.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media") ? `${appeal} ${W.sealAppeal}` : appeal);
    if (standing !== undefined && standing.announced === true && redress.appealNow !== undefined) paragraphs.push(redress.appealNow);
  } else if (input.kind === "correction" && input.outcome === "kept" && input.repliedTo !== undefined && redress.replyAnswered !== undefined) {
    // A kept answer to a reply: the appeal is against the decision it keeps, until the date this answer leaves it; once
    // that date has passed (a late reply answered after the six months), the paragraph for no appeal.
    const until = input.repliedTo.appealUntil;
    paragraphs.push(Date.parse(until) > Date.parse(input.decidedAt) ? redress.replyAnswered.replace("{deadline}", () => utcMinute(until)) : redress.notAppealable);
  } else paragraphs.push(redress.notAppealable);
  return paragraphs;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- an authority's order (3f design, sections 7.10, 9.3, 10.7; W.2, W.3)

/** A post's korbat address as a notice prints it, as text and never as a link: the package holds no origin, so the path. */
const postAddress = (postId: string): string => `/post/${postId}`;

/**
 * The notice of an authority's order (W.2, W.3): one entry a key, each a sentence with the facts it prints, in the words
 * of the design. It is no statement of reasons (DSA Art. 17(5)): no paragraph says that korbat found anything, names a
 * rule or prints an address; each says "the address under Contact in korbat's Terms", since the package holds none. The
 * authority's own words are not here: the screen prints them in their block under the three labels.
 */
export const ORDER_NOTICE = {
  done: {
    disabled: (createdAt: string, address: string, disabledAt: string) =>
      `korbat disabled access to your post of ${createdAt} (${address}) on ${disabledAt}, because it received an order to do so, which this notice describes. Nobody can see the post or its images, you included.`,
    removed: (createdAt: string, address: string, disabledAt: string) =>
      `korbat removed your post of ${createdAt} (${address}) on ${disabledAt}, because it received an order to do so, which this notice describes. Other people can no longer see it; you still can.`,
  },
  lead: {
    tco_removal: (authority: string, state: string, reference: string, dated: string) =>
      `The order is a removal order under Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2021/784 on addressing the dissemination of terrorist content online. It names ${authority}, ${state}, as the authority that issued it, under the reference ${reference}${dated}.`,
    dsa_art9: (authority: string, state: string, reference: string, dated: string) =>
      `The order is an order to act against illegal content, as Article 9 of the Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065) describes it. It names ${authority}, ${state}, as the authority that issued it, under the reference ${reference}${dated}.`,
    confirmed: "korbat has since confirmed that the order comes from that authority.",
  },
  /** `{dated}`: the order's own date once recorded, else the day it reached korbat; nothing when neither is known. */
  dated: { issued: (day: string) => `, and is dated ${day}`, received: (day: string) => `, and reached korbat on ${day}` },
  notAssessed: {
    tco_removal:
      "This is not a decision of korbat's. korbat did not assess your post, under its rules or under the law, and takes no view of it: the law obliges korbat to carry out such an order. No automated means were used: a person at korbat carried it out.",
    dsa_art9:
      "This is not a decision of korbat's. korbat did not assess your post, under its rules or under the law, and takes no view of it: korbat carries out such an order because the law under which it was issued requires it. No automated means were used: a person at korbat carried it out.",
  },
  heldUntilNow: {
    tco_removal: (disabledAt: string, informedAt: string) =>
      `The order came with a decision that you must not be told for a time (Article 11(3) of the Regulation). korbat was not allowed to tell you until now. The post has been disabled since ${disabledAt}; korbat tells you on ${informedAt}.`,
    dsa_art9: (disabledAt: string, informedAt: string) =>
      `The order said that you must not be told until a time its authority set. korbat was not allowed to tell you until now. The post has been disabled since ${disabledAt}; korbat tells you on ${informedAt}. Because you were not to be told, korbat kept the post from you as well, and it stays so for as long as the order's measure stands.`,
    notOrdered: (disabledAt: string, informedAt: string) =>
      `korbat did not tell you of this until now, and that was korbat's own mistake: its record said that the order forbade telling you, and the order did not. The post has been disabled since ${disabledAt}; korbat tells you on ${informedAt}, and regrets the delay.`,
  },
  textsSince: (textsAt: string) => `korbat added the authority's words below to this notice on ${textsAt} and sent you an email that day.`,
  reasonsLabel: "The authority's reasons, in its own words:",
  redressLabel: "How the order can be challenged, in the authority's words:",
  scopeLabel: "The territory the order covers, in the authority's words:",
  /** The label of the block that holds the authority's words, which a screen reader announces. */
  wordsBlock: "The authority's words",
  textsFollow:
    "korbat has not yet recorded the authority's reasons and the ways to challenge the order. It adds them to this notice as soon as it has, and sends you an email when it does. You can ask korbat for a copy of the order now: write, from the email address of your korbat account, to the address under Contact in korbat's Terms, and give the reference above.",
  copy: "You can also ask korbat for a copy of the order: write, from the email address of your korbat account, to the address under Contact in korbat's Terms, and give the reference above.",
  scrutiny: (homeState: string) =>
    `The order comes from another Member State than korbat's. You have the right to ask the competent authority of ${homeState} to scrutinise it, with a reasoned request, within 48 hours of receiving the authority's reasons or a copy of the order (Article 4(4) of the Regulation). korbat cannot make that request for you.`,
  reasonsAt: (at: string) => `This notice has held the authority's reasons since ${at}.`,
  noReasonsYet: "This notice does not hold the authority's reasons yet.",
  /** `preserveUntil` is the first end, six months from the disabling; an extension's later end is `preservedLonger`'s. */
  preserved: (preserveUntil: string) =>
    `korbat keeps the post, its images and a copy of its text until ${preserveUntil}, six months from the disabling, as Article 6 of the Regulation requires, so that it can be reinstated or examined; longer only if an authority or a court asks. Meanwhile korbat shows them to nobody but the authorities and courts the Regulation names, uses them for nothing else, and leaves them out of your data export. Then korbat erases them, and a later reinstatement cannot bring the post back. If you challenge the order, ask the court or the authority to tell korbat to keep the post until it is decided.`,
  preservedLonger: (preserveUntil: string) => `An authority or a court has asked korbat to keep them longer: until ${preserveUntil}.`,
  // 3f's review (people6): the preservation, not six months: an extension or a freeze can make it longer.
  erased: (erasedOn: string) => `The preservation ended on ${erasedOn}. korbat erased the post's text, its images and its copies of them. The post cannot be reinstated.`,
  everywhere: {
    tco_removal: "This applies everywhere korbat is available.",
    dsa_art9: "korbat cannot restrict content for one country alone, so it gave effect to the order everywhere korbat is available, which may be more than the order asks for.",
  },
  reapplied: (lostOn: string) =>
    `The post was first disabled on ${lostOn}. korbat lost its record of that when it had to restore its database from a backup, and disabled the post again with this decision; the six months above count from the first time.`,
  /** 3f's review (people7): the same for a notice that shows no preservation above (a DSA order's, or once erased). */
  reappliedNoPreservation: (lostOn: string) =>
    `The post was first disabled on ${lostOn}. korbat lost its record of that when it had to restore its database from a backup, and disabled the post again with this decision.`,
  noAppeal: {
    tco_removal:
      "korbat's appeal does not apply: this is not korbat's decision, and korbat cannot lift it on its own review. You have the right to challenge the order before the courts of the Member State whose authority issued it (Article 9 of Regulation (EU) 2021/784). How, where and within what time is for that authority to say; korbat passes on what it said in this notice. If the order is withdrawn or annulled, korbat reinstates your post at once and tells you.",
    dsa_art9:
      "korbat's appeal does not apply: this is not korbat's decision, and korbat cannot lift it on its own review. The order's own text says how it can be challenged. How, where and within what time is for that authority to say; korbat passes on what it said in this notice. If the order is withdrawn or annulled, korbat reinstates your post at once and tells you.",
  },
  wrongItem:
    "One thing is korbat's own: whether it disabled the post the order names, and only that. If the order does not name this post, write, from the email address of your korbat account, to the address under Contact in korbat's Terms, with the post's address and the reference above. korbat then compares the post with the order and, if it made that mistake, corrects it and tells you; if not, it answers why.",
  reinstated: {
    lead: (disabledAt: string, createdAt: string, address: string) => `korbat lifted the measure it took on ${disabledAt} for an authority's order on your post of ${createdAt} (${address}).`,
    ground: ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate,
    now: "Your post is shown again as before, unless another decision listed under Settings, Cases still restricts it.",
    erased: (erasedOn: string) => `korbat had already erased the post's content when its preservation ended on ${erasedOn}, so nothing can be shown again.`,
  },
  lifted: "Nothing of the order's measure remains on this post. korbat's appeal does not apply to this. Where another decision about the post still stands, its own screen says whether you can appeal it.",
  /**
   * Task 4 (sections 6.4 and 6.8): an order's records are deleted three years after its last event once nothing of it
   * stands or is untold (erase_order_records). Its decisions stay in the ledger, and their notice then says only that an
   * order was given effect, and when: korbat no longer knows more. The years are ORDER_RULES' (record_keep_years).
   */
  recordsDeleted: {
    done: (createdAt: string, address: string, decidedAt: string) =>
      `korbat restricted your post of ${createdAt} (${address}) on ${decidedAt}, because it received an authority's order to do so.`,
    gone: `korbat has since deleted its record of that order, as its Terms say it does ${ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears} years after an order's last event once nothing of the order still applies, so this notice can say no more about it.`,
  },
} as const;

/**
 * The notice of an order decision, or of the correction that reinstated after one, once the order's records were deleted
 * three years after its last event (Task 4): what was done and when, that the record is gone, and for the correction that
 * nothing of the measure remains. The decision's own times and its post are all it reads.
 */
function orderGoneParagraphs(input: StatementInput): string[] {
  const post = input.post;
  if (post === null) throw new Error("an order's notice is about a post: the decision's data holds none");
  const N = ORDER_NOTICE;
  const created = utcMinute(post.createdAt);
  const address = postAddress(post.id);
  if (input.kind === "correction") return [N.reinstated.lead(utcMinute(input.reviewed!.decidedAt), created, address), N.recordsDeleted.gone, N.lifted];
  return [N.recordsDeleted.done(created, address, utcMinute(input.decidedAt)), N.recordsDeleted.gone];
}

/** What a notice reads besides its statement's data, both read fresh by the API: the authority's words and the day of an erasure. */
export interface OrderNoticeExtras {
  texts?: OrderTexts | null;
  erasedOn?: string | null;
}

/** A Member State's name as a notice prints it, or its code when the contracts do not know it. */
const stateName = (code: string): string => (EU_MEMBER_STATES as Record<string, string>)[code] ?? code;

/**
 * The notice of an order decision, or of the correction that reinstates after one (W.2, W.3), as paragraphs in the
 * table's order. Only the facts korbat knows: until the order is verified the lead says which authority the order names,
 * and only a removal order's notice says that the law obliges korbat. The authority's words themselves are printed by
 * the screen in their block, after these paragraphs.
 */
function orderNoticeParagraphs(input: StatementInput, extras: OrderNoticeExtras): string[] {
  const order = input.order!;
  const post = input.post;
  if (post === null) throw new Error("an order's notice is about a post: the decision's data holds none");
  const N = ORDER_NOTICE;
  const created = utcMinute(post.createdAt);
  const address = postAddress(post.id);
  const disabledAt = utcMinute(order.disabledAt);
  const erasedOn = extras.erasedOn ?? null;
  if (input.kind === "correction") {
    const ground = order.orderGround;
    if (ground === null) throw new Error("a reinstatement after an order names its ground: the decision's data holds none");
    return [N.reinstated.lead(disabledAt, created, address), N.reinstated.ground[ground], erasedOn === null ? N.reinstated.now : N.reinstated.erased(erasedOn), N.lifted];
  }
  const paragraphs: string[] = [];
  const measure = input.measures.find((m) => m.kind === "disable_by_order");
  paragraphs.push(order.withholdAuthor ? N.done.disabled(created, address, disabledAt) : N.done.removed(created, address, disabledAt));
  if (measure?.noEffect === "already") paragraphs.push(W.already("post"));
  if (measure?.noEffect === "deleted") paragraphs.push(W.deletedPost);
  const dated = order.orderedOn === null || order.orderedFrom === null ? "" : N.dated[order.orderedFrom](order.orderedOn);
  const lead = N.lead[order.kind](order.authority, stateName(order.memberState), order.reference, dated);
  paragraphs.push(order.verified ? `${lead} ${N.lead.confirmed}` : lead);
  paragraphs.push(N.notAssessed[order.kind]);
  if (order.held && order.informedAt !== null) {
    const informed = utcMinute(order.informedAt);
    paragraphs.push(order.holdEndReason === "not_ordered" ? N.heldUntilNow.notOrdered(disabledAt, informed) : N.heldUntilNow[order.kind](disabledAt, informed));
  }
  const texts = extras.texts ?? null;
  // The time from which the author holds the newest of the authority's words: the record's, or the telling's when later.
  const addedLater = texts !== null && texts.textsAt !== null && order.informedAt !== null && Date.parse(texts.textsAt) > Date.parse(order.informedAt);
  if (addedLater) paragraphs.push(N.textsSince(utcMinute(texts!.textsAt!)));
  paragraphs.push(texts !== null && texts.reasons !== null && texts.redress !== null ? N.copy : N.textsFollow);
  if (order.kind === "tco_removal" && order.crossBorder) {
    const home = order.homeState === null ? "korbat's Member State" : stateName(order.homeState);
    // 3f's review (people2): since the reasons themselves were held, the later of their record and the telling, never
    // since a later record of the remedies or the scope.
    const reasonsLater = texts !== null && texts.reasonsAt !== null && order.informedAt !== null && Date.parse(texts.reasonsAt) > Date.parse(order.informedAt);
    const reasonsAt = texts !== null && texts.reasons !== null ? (reasonsLater ? texts!.reasonsAt : order.informedAt) : null;
    paragraphs.push(`${N.scrutiny(home)} ${reasonsAt === null ? N.noReasonsYet : N.reasonsAt(utcMinute(reasonsAt))}`);
  }
  let preserved = false;
  if (order.kind === "tco_removal") {
    if (erasedOn !== null) paragraphs.push(N.erased(erasedOn));
    else if (order.preserveUntil !== null && order.preserveEndedOn === null) {
      // 3f's review (people6): the first end is six months from the disabling; an extended one is printed apart, as longer.
      paragraphs.push(N.preserved(utcMinute(order.preserveFirstUntil ?? order.preserveUntil)));
      if (order.preserveExtended) paragraphs.push(N.preservedLonger(utcMinute(order.preserveUntil)));
      preserved = true;
    }
  }
  paragraphs.push(N.everywhere[order.kind]);
  // Task 6: a disabling taken again after a restore names the first disabling's day; its six months count from then. A
  // notice that shows no preservation above has no six months to refer to (3f's review, people7).
  if (input.reapplied) paragraphs.push(preserved ? N.reapplied(input.reapplied.lostOn) : N.reappliedNoPreservation(input.reapplied.lostOn));
  paragraphs.push(N.noAppeal[order.kind]);
  paragraphs.push(N.wrongItem);
  return paragraphs;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- an image korbat lost (3d design, sections 7.1, 9.6; W.8)

/**
 * The words about an image whose files korbat lost while they were kept apart in the quarantine (3d design, sections 7.1
 * and 9.6; W.8): the mail `image_lost`, sent once, with the day of the post the image is on, and the sentence the app
 * prints in the place of that image for its author ([image.lost]). Neither names a file, a seal or a person; neither
 * tells the author to wait, since the image cannot come back.
 */
export const IMAGE_LOST_NOTICE = {
  mail: (createdAt: string) =>
    `korbat lost the files of an image of your post of ${createdAt} while they were kept apart from its other images. The image cannot be shown again. You can delete the post, or post the image again. This is korbat's fault, not a decision about you.`,
  onImage: "korbat lost this image's files while they were kept apart from its other images. It cannot be shown again. You can delete the post, or post the image again.",
  /** 3d review L16: the mail's last paragraph, where korbat shows the loss: on the post, in the image's place ([image.lost]). */
  mailWhere: "In korbat, your post shows the same in the place of the image.",
} as const;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- a release of sealed images (3d design, sections 7.2, 9.6; W.6)

/**
 * The author's notice of a release (3d design, W.6), which is not a decision: what korbat did, on what ground, and nothing
 * of what any authority found. It never prints an authority's name, a reference or an assessment, and every sentence says
 * "released", none "no longer holds" or a past "destroyed": at the commit the files are still in the quarantine, and a
 * backup may hold them until a day it names. The mail `release_notice`, the app's notice screen and the console share it.
 */
export const RELEASE_NOTICE = {
  lead: {
    one: (createdAt: string, images: number) => `korbat has released the sealed images of your post of ${createdAt} (${images} in all): it will not show them again or give them back.`,
    several: (posts: number, images: number) => `korbat has released the sealed images of ${posts} of your posts (${images} in all): it will not show them again or give them back.`,
    upload: "korbat has released an image that you uploaded and korbat did not accept: it will not give it back.",
  },
  basis: {
    leave: (releasedAt: string, backupsClearAt: string) =>
      `An admin released them on ${releasedAt}. The ground is the leave or instruction of an authority or a court to destroy them. korbat erased its record of the images and destroys the files. A backup of korbat's can hold them until ${backupsClearAt}, and longer only where an authority has korbat keep one.`,
    period: (releasedAt: string, backupsClearAt: string) =>
      `The authority korbat had reported them to did not answer within the time korbat's terms give for that. An admin released them on ${releasedAt}, as korbat told you beforehand: korbat erased its record of the images and destroys the files. A backup of korbat's can hold them until ${backupsClearAt}, and longer only where an authority has korbat keep one.`,
  },
  what: "A person did this, not a program. It cannot be undone: the images cannot be shown again or given back. The text of your post is not touched.",
  /**
   * 3d review L11 (people9): the decision that sealed, by where its author's appeal of it stands when the notice is
   * rendered (ReleaseNoticeView.appeal): a release closes no appeal, and an answered one is not said to be open.
   */
  seal: {
    none: "The decision that sealed the images stays on record under Settings, Cases. Its screen says whether you can still appeal it. This notice is not a new decision about you, and nothing else changes with it.",
    pending: "The decision that sealed the images stays on record under Settings, Cases. Your appeal of it is still open, and an admin reviews it. This notice is not a new decision about you, and nothing else changes with it.",
    answered: "The decision that sealed the images stays on record under Settings, Cases, with the answer to your appeal of it. This notice is not a new decision about you, and nothing else changes with it.",
  },
  /**
   * 3d review M14 (people3): a held upload's release, which was one image on no post, sealed by no decision and open to
   * no appeal: its own ground (always a leave: upload_release takes no other), what a release is, and where its notice
   * is, the refused upload's own under Settings, Cases, whose paragraph `released` then says it.
   */
  upload: {
    basis: (releasedAt: string, backupsClearAt: string) =>
      `An admin released it on ${releasedAt}. The ground is the leave or instruction of an authority or a court to destroy it. korbat erased its record of the image and destroys its files. A backup of korbat's can hold them until ${backupsClearAt}, and longer only where an authority has korbat keep one.`,
    what: "A person did this, not a program. It cannot be undone: the image cannot be given back.",
    notice: "Your notice under Settings, Cases that korbat did not accept the image now says that korbat released it. Nothing else changes with this notice.",
  },
  redress:
    "You can write to korbat about this at the address under Contact in korbat's Terms. You can also go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).",
} as const;

/**
 * The notice's paragraphs, a pure function of ReleaseNoticeView: the lead by the number of posts (or a held upload), the
 * ground, what a release is, the seal's decision by where its appeal stands, and the redress; a held upload's release its
 * own ground, what a release is and where its notice is (3d review M14). Every time is printed as korbat's mails print
 * one, the date and the minute in UTC.
 */
export function releaseNoticeParagraphs(
  view: Pick<ReleaseNoticeView, "basis" | "releasedAt" | "backupsClearAt" | "upload" | "postCount" | "images" | "appeal"> & { posts: readonly { createdAt: string }[] },
): string[] {
  const N = RELEASE_NOTICE;
  const releasedAt = utcMinute(view.releasedAt);
  const backupsClearAt = utcMinute(view.backupsClearAt);
  if (view.upload) return [N.lead.upload, N.upload.basis(releasedAt, backupsClearAt), N.upload.what, N.upload.notice, N.redress];
  const first = view.posts[0];
  const lead = view.postCount === 1 && first !== undefined ? N.lead.one(utcMinute(first.createdAt), view.images) : N.lead.several(view.postCount, view.images);
  return [lead, N.basis[view.basis](releasedAt, backupsClearAt), N.what, N.seal[view.appeal], N.redress];
}

/**
 * The day of a release by period (W.6), told to the author beforehand. Dormant while release_rules().silence_days is null:
 * no route, screen or mail of 3d sends it, and the task that sets the period builds them with the terms' sentence.
 */
export const RELEASE_DAY_NOTICE = (createdAt: string, day: string) =>
  `The authority korbat reported the sealed images of your post of ${createdAt} to has not answered. Under korbat's terms an admin may release them on or after ${day}: korbat then erases its record of them and destroys the files, and that cannot be undone. If you want them kept, object before that day, on this notice's screen under Settings, Cases: an objection that is unanswered on that day holds the release until an admin has answered it.`;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- a refused upload (3d design, sections 7.12, 9.5; W.5)

/**
 * The refused upload's notice (3d design, W.5), which is not a decision of 3c's ledger: rendered fresh from the refusal's
 * row and its match, so its state paragraph follows the hold. It speaks only of an acting match (the one that refuses),
 * with W.3's comparison for `csam` and "the file you uploaded"; it never says what the image is, that korbat confirmed
 * it, that anyone posted it, or that nobody has seen it. The app's notice screen and the mails upload_refused and
 * upload_hold_lifted share it. Its numbers are the contracts' (ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays, AUTOMATION_RULES.matchKeepDays).
 */
export const UPLOAD_NOTICE = {
  refused: (refusedAt: string) => `korbat did not accept an image you uploaded on ${refusedAt}. It is on no post, and nobody can see it, you included.`,
  automated: (comparison: string) => `This was done by automated means, and no person took part: ${comparison}.`,
  rule: (title: string) => `The rule this was done under: korbat rule R2, "${title}". What korbat compares, and with whom, is stated under Automation on the rules page.`,
  held: `korbat keeps the file, unopened, until an admin has decided what happens to it. The admin decides without opening it: either korbat reports it to the authorities and keeps it for them alone, or the hold ends and korbat deletes the file. Nobody at korbat can accept the image, since nobody opens it. No timer ends the hold. korbat tells you here, and by email when the hold is lifted. If you delete your account while the file is held, korbat keeps your email address, and nothing else of the account, for up to ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days from the refusal (Terms, Your data).`,
  objected: (objectedAt: string) => `You objected on ${objectedAt}. An admin reads what you wrote and decides.`,
  ended: {
    noReport: (endedAt: string) =>
      `An admin ended the hold on ${endedAt} without a report, and korbat deletes the file. ${AUTOMATION_RULES.matchKeepDays} days after the hold ended korbat erases the fingerprint and the link between this record and your account; what it keeps after that is that an upload was refused on that day, with nothing that leads to you (Terms, Your data).`,
    withdrew: (source: string) => `${source} withdrew or corrected its entry: you can upload the image again.`,
    stillListed: (source: string) =>
      `The image is still not accepted while ${source}'s list holds a matching entry. If you think the entry is wrong, ${source} is the body that can correct it: korbat cannot, since nobody at korbat opens the image.`,
    report: (endedAt: string) => `On ${endedAt} an admin decided, without opening the file, that korbat reports it to the authorities. korbat keeps the file for them alone.`,
    reportKept: "The record of that report names your account and keeps its email address for as long as korbat keeps its records to authorities (Terms, Your data).",
  },
  released: (releasedAt: string) => `korbat released the file on ${releasedAt}, on the leave or instruction of an authority or a court: it will not give it back, and it destroys it.`,
  /** The mails' last paragraph: where to read it, and that korbat's mails hold no link to act on a notice. */
  mailRead: "Read it, and object if you wish, in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a notice.",
  mailReadLifted: "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a notice.",
} as const;

/**
 * The notice's paragraphs (W.5), a pure function of UploadRefusalView and the rule's title, in their order, each only when
 * its condition holds: refused; automated means with the comparison; not assessed; the rule; held while the hold stands
 * (and while an end as no_report is in its delay, which the view hides); the objection's offer while it is open, or the
 * objection; the end; the release. Every time is printed as korbat's mails print one.
 */
export function uploadNoticeParagraphs(view: UploadRefusalView, ruleTitle: string, redress: Pick<RedressTexts, "uploadObject">): string[] {
  const N = UPLOAD_NOTICE;
  const paragraphs = [
    N.refused(utcMinute(view.refusedAt)),
    N.automated(W.automated.comparison("csam", view.matchKind, view.source, "the file you uploaded")),
    W.automated.notAssessed("csam", view.matchKind, "an upload"),
    N.rule(ruleTitle),
  ];
  if (view.endAs === null) paragraphs.push(N.held);
  if (view.mayObject) {
    if (redress.uploadObject === undefined) throw new Error("a refused upload's notice needs the redress uploadObject");
    paragraphs.push(redress.uploadObject);
  }
  if (view.objection !== null) paragraphs.push(N.objected(utcMinute(view.objection.objectedAt)));
  if (view.endAs === "no_report" && view.endedAt !== null) {
    paragraphs.push(`${N.ended.noReport(utcMinute(view.endedAt))} ${view.endReason === "source_withdrew" ? N.ended.withdrew(view.source) : N.ended.stillListed(view.source)}`);
  }
  if (view.endAs === "report" && view.endedAt !== null) paragraphs.push(view.reportKept ? `${N.ended.report(utcMinute(view.endedAt))} ${N.ended.reportKept}` : N.ended.report(utcMinute(view.endedAt)));
  if (view.released !== null) paragraphs.push(N.released(utcMinute(view.released)));
  return paragraphs;
}
